Hm, let's try this...

I can't believe it!  This stuff is... terrible!  That's great!

Well I guess Stoley can keep the money he owes me.  He's true to his word about Steamwheedle bilge rum.  That stuff is as thick as gravel and burns like lava!

objectives.text: Bring Stoley's Bottle to "Sea Wolf" MacKinley in Booty Bay.

progress.text: Did Stoley cough up my booze?

complete.text:
Ah, Andre's head.  So I guess he'll make his trial after all!

Much appreciated, $N.  Now if you'll just sign here, I can issue you payment for services rendered.

Don't worry about the small print.  It's harmless, and... I don't think there's a magnifying glass small enough to read it anyway.

progress.text: You look a little dazed.  Have you been reading our legal documents?

accept.text: This scroll contains the schedules of shipments between Steamwheedle Port and Booty Bay. Both past and future shipments are included, along with ship names, with large 'X's next to some ships' journeys, and annotations like "GREAT LOOT" and "HARD FIGHT" next to others.$B$BSomeone at Steamwheedle Port would want to see this document.

complete.text:
Oh my, this looks to be a list of ship departures and arrivals, with accurate dates and times and everything!  If the captain of a pirate ship got his hands on this, he could have himself a field day!

You say you got this from a pirate?  Well that's disturbing news...

Thank you, $N.  I'm glad you took it from him, and I'm glad that pirate's eating dirt right now!

objectives.text: Report the Ship Schedules to an authority in Steamwheedle Port.

progress.text: You look out of breath.  You have something to tell me?

accept.text: This map shows a stretch of beach with a southern face.  Below the map are words, elegantly written...$B$B$BSouth of Wheedle$BSouth of home$BFind a mast and flag and bones$BDig you there, if you be bold$BDig and claim Cuergo's gold!$BA key you'll need and a key you'll see$BThe men you face take blood as fee.

complete.text: Captain Cuergo's hidden treasure awaits!

objectives.text: Find Cuergo's gold!

progress.text: This chest is locked!

accept.text: A nigh-universal mechanical component--the essential artificial--was of great use to the tinkers and smiths of Gnomeregan.  But during the frantic exodus from our city, no one remembered to take any of these devices with them!  And I need a large supply of them for work I will soon undertake.$B$BPlease, go into Gnomeregan and get me some essential artificials.  You'll find them in the deeper areas of our city, held in containers called artificial extrapolators.$B$BThank you, $n, and please hurry!

objectives.text: Bring 12 Essential Artificials to Klockmort Spannerspan in Ironforge.

accept.text: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, $n. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Drusilla, one of our local trainers. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.

complete.text:
As you grow in power, you will be tempted--you must always remember to control yourself. I will not lie--corruption can come to any practitioner of the arcane; especially one who deals with creatures from the Twisting Nether. Be patient, and be prudent... but do not let that repress your ambition.

As you grow more powerful, return to me and I will teach you more about our ways.

objectives.text: Read the Tainted Letter and speak to Drusilla La Salle next to Northshire Abbey.

progress.text: Ah, so you've arrived, and not a moment too soon, $N. Some of the guards were over here a moment ago and were giving me curious looks... pathetic mundanes.

accept.text: $n, I'm a scientist, but also a treasure hunter at heart!$B$BLong ago, when trolls used to occupy this land, they created large amounts of ornaments modeled after Gahz'rilla, a hydra they worshipped as a deity. These ornaments are carved out of an element that I call "Gahz'ridian," after the hydra god.$B$BI did find some myself, but I'd like to have some more to study -- maybe you can find some?$B$BI even invented a detector that makes finding the Gahz'ridian a snap! Just put it on, and the search begins!

complete.text:
Perfect; these ornaments are perfect for my studies. Thanks so much for the help, $N.

Oh, can I get my helmet back?

objectives.text: Marvon Rivetseeker in Tanaris wants you to collect 30 Gahz'ridian Ornaments.

progress.text:
Are you having any trouble?

You can find Gahz'ridian just about anywhere in Tanaris, $N, so keep looking!

complete.text:
They're that big? I might have to rethink my plan...

But you did hold up your end of the bargain, so here's what I promised.

Yes, the Sunken Temple, I can say that I have seen it with my own eyes. Perhaps you'd like to hear more about it?

You look like the adventurous type -- I know things that may intrigue you...

accept.text: I once entered the foreboding chambers of the Sunken Temple. The evil in that place penetrates all that enter; I barely managed to find my way out, wading through the ooze that now covers the floors. All I can remember is stumbling through a large circular room, filled with serpent statues...$B$BRecently, I discovered a round stone that appeared to have the same serpent symbol imprinted on it. I had it packed up and shipped to my workshop in Ratchet. Retrieve it, and I might be able to tell you more.

objectives.text: Retrieve the Stone Circle from Marvon Rivetseeker's workshop in Ratchet.

accept.text: I admit, $n, I've made the most of my situation in Azshara. Belgrom's punishment has had its share of benefits.$B$BBefore I left, I did some research and you would be surprised how many valuable items are lying around.$B$BThere are tablets throughout the Ruins of Eldarath to the east that I need. All four are named after highborne wizards. Get them for me and we'll talk some more.

objectives.text: Find the Tablet of Beth'Amara, the Tablet of Jin'yael, the Tablet of Markri, and the Tablet of Sael'hai for Jediga in Valormok.

accept.text: See that tauren behind me--the one who looks like she's going to be ill at any moment? She was in Azshara recently. She claims she was wounded by some naga while making her way through the Ruins of Eldarath.$B$BAfter fighting off a few of them, she took a break on the beach and drank from one of the tide pools. Now she's feeling nauseous... among other things.$B$BI'd like to find out what she drank. Take this box, in it are some empty vials I labeled. Fill each at different pools and come back.

objectives.text: Fill all 4 Empty Vials at the tide pools along the coast of the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara before returning to Chemist Cuely.

accept.text: You've shown yourself a dependable $c, $n.  Dependable, and not afraid to get your hands dirty, eh?$B$BI have a friend, Milly Osworth, who's in some trouble.  She's over with her wagon on the other side of the abbey, near the stable.  I'm sure she could use a pair of hands like yours.

complete.text:
Oh, Deputy Willem told you to speak with me?  He's a brave man and always willing to help, but his duties keep him stuck at Northshire Abbey and I'm afraid the problem I have today is beyond him.

Perhaps you can help me?

objectives.text: Speak with Milly Osworth.

accept.text: A gang of brigands, the Defias, moved into the Northshire Vineyards while I was harvesting!  I reported it to the Northshire guards and they assured me they'd take care of things, but... I'm afraid for my crop of grapes!  If the Defias don't steal them then I fear our guards will trample them when they chase away the thugs.$B$BPlease, you must help me!  I gathered most of my grapes into buckets, but I left them in the vineyards to the southeast.$B$BBring me those crates!  Save my harvest!

complete.text:
Oh thank you, $N!  You saved my harvest!  And I hope you showed a few of those Defias that they can't cause trouble around here.

We might be short on guards these days, but we're lucky to have heroes like you to protect us!

objectives.text: Bring 8 crates of Milly's Harvest to Milly Osworth at Northshire Abbey.

progress.text: Do you have my harvest, $N?

accept.text: Now that my crop is saved, take this Grape Manifest to Brother Neals.  He manages the store of food and drink in Northshire, and I'm sure he'll be delighted to hear that he has fresh grapes.$B$BYou'll find Brother Neals in the abbey, in the bell tower... where he likes to taste his wine.

complete.text:
Let's see here...

Oh my!  Milly's grapes have been saved!  When she told me that brigands overran her vineyards I nearly despaired, but my faith in the Light did not waver!

And through your bravery,  we now have grapes for more wine!  May the Light bless you, $N, and keep you safe!

objectives.text: Bring the Grape Manifest to Brother Neals in Northshire Abbey.

progress.text: You look to be in fine spirits!  Come!  Have a seat, and have a drink!

accept.text: Shadowmaster Vivian Lagrave is in need of your services.  She is in the Badlands, in the orcish outpost of Kargath, pursuing rumors of a certain brew made by the Dark Iron dwarves of Blackrock Depths.$B$BSpeak with Vivian.  She awaits you.

objectives.text: Speak with Shadowmaster Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.

accept.text: Felwood is a forest far north of the Barrens, even farther than Ashenvale. There, slimes are found all around pools of water blessed by the touch of Fel. The Scourge decimated the area with attacks of Infernals and other demonic magics--the slimes supposedly crept up through the earth during these attacks.$B$BGather samples of Felwood slimes and we will use the testing equipment next to me to create a control group for our tests against other samples you gather.

objectives.text: Gather Felwood Slime Samples from any of the slimes in Felwood. Then, using the Testing Equipment next to Chemist Fuely in Undercity, see which of your samples are the most corrupt. Bring 5 of the Corrupted Felwood Samples you find to Chemist Fuely.

accept.text: Have you heard of the Un'Goro Crater, $n? It is near the Tanaris desert, and it is a magnificent place: lush, vibrant, full of creatures and plant life.$B$BIt is there you must go. Word has reached me that the place seems completely untainted by outside hands. Explorers are just now discovering its secrets.$B$BI would like to test the slimes or oozes there. If it is true--that they are uncorrupt--then I would like to see how such creatures have evolved.

objectives.text: Gather Un'Goro Slime Samples from any of the slimes in Un'Goro Crater. Then, using the Testing Equipment next to Chemist Fuely in Undercity, see which of your samples are the most pure. Bring 5 of the Pure Un'Goro Samples you find to Chemist Fuely.

accept.text: Although my little brother Ribbly has been worthless his whole life, I think, finally, he has some value!  But... we might need your help to capitalize on Ribbly's newfound worth.$B$BMy sister Yuka has been looking for him for weeks, and tracked him to the Burning Steppes.  She sent word to me, asking for some hired hands.$B$BSo, what do you say?  Want to help?  If so, then speak with my sister.  You'll find her holed up in Flame Crest, a cave northwest of Dreadmaul Rock.

objectives.text: Speak with Yuka Screwspigot in the Burning Steppes.

accept.text: It would seem that the silithid's intent, nay - reason for being, is to devour everything in their path that is not of their ecology.  Their focus is singular, and it is for this reason they are a grave threat to all life on Azeroth.$B$BWhat we've seen to date is but the first stages.  I suspect that their strength comes from deeper in Kalimdor: Un'Goro Crater.  Go to Gadgetzan in the Tanaris desert and speak to Alchemist Pestlezugg.  Tell him of my theory; he will surely aid us in fighting the silithid.

objectives.text: Speak to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.

accept.text: Being an apprentice to Marvon Rivetseeker, I've learned so much. But he's been gone for such a long time now, so I think I'm going to work on some experiments of my own.$B$BI've been reading about Un'Goro Crater most recently, and about the strange volcanic activity going on in the middle of the crater. I think a lot could be learned if I could just get some of the ash from the elementals there.$B$BDo you think you'd mind collecting some for me, if you are going that way?

objectives.text: Collect 9 samples of Un'Goro Ash from the fire elementals around the volcano in Un'Goro Crater, and return them to Liv Rizzlefix in Ratchet.

accept.text: The Forsaken apothecaries are not the only beings in this world schooled in the sciences.$B$BI have been studying the plague for years, $r. We had previously thought that the potency of the plague was dwindling, but what I have discovered here in the Plaguelands is startling. The plague seems to be growing in strength!$B$BI need to run more tests! The most potent source of the plague is from the tainted flesh of the most recently infected. Travel to Stratholme and bring me samples, $n.

complete.text: There is something that has changed in the chemical structure of the plague's active agents. More data is required.

objectives.text: Recover 20 Plagued Flesh Samples from Stratholme and return them to Betina Bigglezink. You suspect that any creature in Stratholme would have said flesh sample.

progress.text: Some say I worry too much - to them I say, 'You don't worry enough!'

accept.text: You will have to delve deeper into Stratholme, $n.$B$BBeyond the first gates you will find the ziggurats. We know that the Scourge draws great power from these structures. Search the Ziggurats and return with any information that you may discover.

objectives.text: Travel to Stratholme and search the ziggurats. Find and return new Scourge Data to Betina Bigglezink.

accept.text: Terrible thing... what happened to Ezra. You see, the town was sacked and Ezra didn't want to leave his precious goods behind. The last thing I remember him saying was, 'I'll burn every last leaf before they get their damned, dirty hands on them!'$B$BI may love a good stogie but I'm no fool. I left Ezra and his delightful store that day. I assume he went down in flames but if there's a chance that even one box of his famous tobacco is still intact...$B$BWhat do you say, $n? Find a box for ol' Smokey?

objectives.text: Find Ezra Grimm's smoke shop in Stratholme and recover a box of Grimm's Premium Tobacco. Return to Smokey LaRue when the job is done.

accept.text: I look at my undeath as a malady, $r. An illness that merely requires treatment; however, it is also a great blessing for the Argent Dawn. What better vessel to smite the heathens of the Scourge than through the undead?$B$BI am revered by my colleagues because of the sacrifices I have made, but the accolades mean nothing to me.$B$BIf you are interested in assisting the Argent Dawn, then a job I can offer.$B$BVenture to Stratholme and recover our surplus of holy water. Search the supply crates.

objectives.text: Travel to Stratholme, in the north. Search the supply crates that litter the city and recover 5 Stratholme Holy Water. Return to Leonid Barthalomew the Revered when you have collected enough of the blessed fluid.

accept.text: Anything taken to an extreme is hazardous to our world, $n. Take for example, the Scarlet Crusade. Do you believe that their blind zealotry serves a greater good? How many innocents have they destroyed in the name of the Light?$B$BBlasphemers, one and all!$B$BOne in particular interests me, though; the Archivist Galford of Stratholme: A man that watches over the Crusade's most valued documents. Destroy him and burn down his archives! Should you succeed, return to me and be rewarded.

objectives.text: Travel to Stratholme and find Archivist Galford of the Scarlet Crusade. Destroy him and burn down the Scarlet Archive.

accept.text: Eagan Peltskinner is looking for someone to hunt wolves for him.  That's good news, because we're seeing a lot more wolves in Northshire Valley lately.$B$BIf you're interested then speak with Eagan.  He's around the side of the abbey, to the left.

complete.text: That's true.  I'm looking for someone to hunt me some wolves!  Are you that person?

objectives.text: Speak with Eagan Peltskinner.

accept.text: There are those that died tragically in the fall of Stratholme. Many took their own lives, opting to hurl themselves into the myriad flames of the smoldering city rather than become one of the Scourge.$B$BThey now walk the streets of Stratholme as restless spirits.$B$BWe must aid them, $n!$B$BI have an associate named Egan who has been doing miraculous work with ghosts and souls. Seek him out. He walks the eastern Plaguelands, near Stratholme, testing his innovations.

objectives.text: Find Egan. You only know that he was last seen around Stratholme.

accept.text: Within the Scholomance lays the Barov family fortune. I, Alexi Barov, am one of the last two remaining heirs of the house Barov. My brother, Weldon, is the other.$B$BWeldon, the miserable coward, fled during the war and thus retained his worthless existence as a human.$B$BHe now searches for the deeds so that he may claim the fortune for his own. Recover the deeds before my brother does and I shall make you wealthy beyond your wildest dreams!

objectives.text: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Alexi Barov when you have completed this task.

accept.text: Krastinov is responsible for the deaths of thousands. He must be punished, justice must be meted out.$B$BFind him and exact upon him the agony he has inflicted upon countless innocents. Once he is destroyed, burn our remains. Turn them to ashes, $n.

objectives.text: Find Doctor Theolen Krastinov inside the Scholomance. Destroy him, then burn the Remains of Eva Sarkhoff and the Remains of Lucien Sarkhoff. Return to Eva Sarkhoff when the task is complete.

complete.text:
All who fight evil on behalf of the Argent Dawn must don our commission.  Wearing such will earn your right to claim rewards our quartermasters have to offer.

While under commission, you'll be able to acquire Scourgestones from slain Scourge; these are marks of insignia that they sometimes possess.  Procure these insignia and bring them to me.  For each set you turn in, you will receive our marker of heroism - the Argent Dawn Valor Token.

Achieve your destiny, $c - join the fight today!

accept.text: The Argent Dawn recently learned that the Scourge are creating their own plagued dragonflight!  We must stop them -- if the Scourge gain a force of dragons they'll sweep across Azeroth unchecked!$B$BTheir necromancers are breeding plagued dragons at the Scholomance, in the middle of Darrowmere Lake.$B$BGo to the Scholomance and kill as many hatchlings as you can... before they get any bigger!

complete.text:
Well done, $N!  It'll be a long time before they can grow another clutch of dragons.

...At least, I hope it will!

objectives.text: Kill 20 Plagued Hatchlings, then return to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's Hope Chapel.

accept.text: This is a scale shed from a plagued dragon hatchling.  But unlike the other pocked, oozing scales on the infant beast, this rare scale is healthy and unmarred.$B$BBetina Bigglezink will want a sample of this to study.

complete.text: Excellent!  This will be invaluable in my continued studies of the machinations of the Scourge.  Thank you, $N, and if you find more of these scales please bring them to me!

objectives.text: Bring the Healthy Dragon Scale to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.

progress.text: $N, do you have something to show me?

complete.text: I'm so glad you were able to do this for me, $N! Thanks for your help!

accept.text: Get me out of here!$B$BI came up to the Valley of Spears to talk to the Maraudines.  I thought I could do a little business with them... but they don't want to talk!  I think they want to eat me!$B$BGet me out of here and my brother Hornizz will pay you big!  He's at our camp next to the kodo graveyard, to the east.$B$BLet's hurry, $n.  Not two minutes ago I heard some centaurs talking about getting wood for their cookpot...

objectives.text: Escort Melizza Brimbuzzle, then speak with Hornizz Brimbuzzle at the Kodo Graveyard in Desolace.

accept.text: The crystal caverns of Terramok lie to the west, deep within Maraudon... It is an ancient place with much history. And I am looking to get my hands on some of it, $c. Relics of the old gods lie hidden behind the giant doors.$B$BIf you are willing to brave the twisted evils found in Maraudon, I believe I can make it worth your time. Collect the theradric crystal carvings you find, and return them to me.$B$BOnce I get the carvings, I will be able to... study them. These powers have been too long at rest...

complete.text:
Ha ha ha! I knew you'd be back.

<Willow mutters.>

...So easy to convince.

...Will do anything for the right price. Heh heh heh...

objectives.text: Collect 25 Theradric Crystal Carvings for Willow in Desolace.

progress.text:
Don't ask questions!

You have my request.

accept.text: A satyr known as Vyletongue has corrupted the caverns of Maraudon, stunting the growth of many of the plants inside.$B$BTake this vial, $n. Fill it at the orange crystal pool found inside the caverns; the coating inside the vial will counter the toxins, turning it into a healing agent.$B$BFind the Vylestem vines inside the orange caverns, and use the purified liquid on them. The corruption will be purged from the plant, but do know that Vyletongue will still control it. He may use it against you...

complete.text:
Thank you for returning this, $N. With the remaining liquid you brought me, I can continue my studies.

While there is still much to do, you have helped to heal some of the corruption that Vyletongue spread through Maraudon. Please take this with my gratitude.

objectives.text: Fill the Coated Cerulean Vial at the orange crystal pool in Maraudon.$B$BUse the Filled Cerulean Vial on the Vylestem Vines to force the corrupted Noxxious Scion to emerge.$B$BHeal 8 plants by killing these Noxxious Scion, then return to Vark Battlescar in Shadowprey Village.

progress.text: If you are able to heal the plant, it will again begin to grow. We must do what we can, $N...

accept.text: A dark satyr called Lord Vyletongue spread his evil through these twisting caves, poisoning the minds of all inside. He still resides beyond the purple crystals.$B$BVyletongue also created a living symbol of his corruption called Noxxion that dwells beyond the orange crystals. Together, they have stolen the two parts of my brother's scepter. Celebras, my brother... he wanders blindly inside, cursed by corruption.$B$BYou must help him! Find the pieces, and speak to my brother... somehow.

complete.text: Now that you have recovered the two parts of my scepter, I have hope that Maraudon may one day be rid of the Vyle corruption.

objectives.text: Recover the two parts of the Scepter of Celebras: the Celebrian Rod and the Celebrian Diamond.$B$BFind a way to speak with Celebras.

progress.text: I have awoken from a nightmare that seemed it would never end...

accept.text: My scepter was once a source of hope for me. Its power allowed me the freedom to travel quickly through these caverns. I had hoped to bring peace to the spirit of my uncle... It is a task that I now pass to you.$B$BFor the two parts to once again become one, I will need your assistance in performing the ritual. Please follow me, and listen to my instructions while I channel the energy required to reunite the rod with the diamond.$B$BTogether, we shall create the Scepter of Celebras once again!

complete.text:
Please take this, and know that the power allotted to you now must be used for good. Continue your journey through the caverns, and with hope, you will find the remains of my uncle. Much danger awaits you, $N.

Speak with me again should the need arise.

objectives.text: Assist Celebras the Redeemed while he creates the Scepter of Celebras.$B$BSpeak with him when the ritual is complete.

accept.text: Deep in Maraudon lives an evil creature of chaos--Princess Theradras is an elemental force of earth related to the Old Gods. Ages ago, she and Zaetar, first son of Cenarius, began a relationship. The offspring of their time together became known to the people of Kalimdor as centaur. Ever-thankful creatures, the centaur killed Zaetar, and now hold Zaetar's remains. My quest here is to find those powerful enough to slay Theradras so we may recover Zaetar's remains before returning to Stonetalon.

complete.text:
This is most wonderful news, $N! Thank you!

I will speak with Marandis and ask his wisdom on the topic of Zaetar's remains, but at least you have overcome the hardest of the tasks.

I was told that if we were successful in our mission, I had permission to reward those who aided us. I was given these items as tokens from our people--you may choose one.

objectives.text: Slay Princess Theradras and return to Selendra near Shadowprey Village in Desolace.

accept.text: The misbegotten centaur--my sons and daughters--have need of their father.$B$BLook around you--this place rings of hope and all that my father Cenarius preaches. It sprung from me! And I cannot take that away from them... not even for their crimes against me.$B$BBut there is one thing I would ask of you to ease my brother's mind. Take this... it is the first seed that fell from the life my remains nourished. Tell him my spirit remains here, and that I live on. I am sure he will understand.

objectives.text: Seek out Remulos in Moonglade and give him the Seed of Life.

progress.text:
You have the scent of corruption on you, $N... much like many adventurers these days. But something about you is different. Is there something you've come to speak to me about? You have an aura about you that seems familiar, but I cannot place it.

Please, I implore you, tell me why you've sought an audience with me.

accept.text: Though exiled as a heretic, my beliefs still ring true--that alone drives me onward. But for my destiny to be complete, I need the aid of an outsider... one not of any centaur tribe.$B$BThe task requires someone to enter the holy halls of Maraudon--a tomb my people protect, and only the most devout are ever allowed to enter.$B$BIf you agree to aid me, then you need only nod. I will pass you a parchment with my instructions on it. Read it over and consider my words.

complete.text:
This is it, skyborne! This is it! Now I can begin the great task of uniting the tribes. Thank you.

Take this for your efforts, please. I hope when next we meet, it will be on much different terms.

objectives.text: Read the Pariah's Instructions. Afterwards, obtain the Amulet of Union from Maraudon and return it to the Centaur Pariah in southern Desolace.

progress.text: What did you decide, $N? Can you help me? Will you set foot on holy ground to help me forge one great centaur tribe!?

Greetings, skyborne. I am Kolark, Bounty Hunter from Thunderbluff. Much of the world I have traveled and much I have seen.

My journeys across the South Seas led to the discovery of these wonderous thorium headed arrows. Alas, I have an endless supply of the arrows but have exhausted my supply of shells. Bah, no self respecting Tauren would ever be caught dead using a flimsy bow. The arrows are useless!

I will offer a trade: An even exchange of thorium shells for my thorium headed arrows. Deal?

accept.text: I had let my guard down for only one moment, stranger. In my haste to escape the grip of the fallen Prince, I was robbed. A most foul demon, the imp Pusillin, pilfered my book of incantations and the key to the once great halls of Eldre'Thalas.$B$BI no longer hold interest in the key, as I have exchanged my immortality for freedom, but I desperately need my book of incantations.$B$BFind the imp, Pusillin, and recover my book.$B$BSearch the Warpwood Quarter of Dire Maul for Pusillin.

complete.text: You have found it! A curse upon that miserable imp. Alas, my material possessions are meager at best. You may choose from what I have to offer.

objectives.text: Travel to Dire Maul and locate the Imp, Pusillin. Convince Pusillin to give you Azj'Tordin's Book of Incantations through any means necessary.$B$BReturn to Azj'Tordin at the Lariss Pavilion in Feralas should you recover the Book of Incantations.

progress.text: I regret nothing, stranger. The Queen has long since passed. The works of the Shen'Dralar have been marred by the madness of Prince Tortheldrin. I seek only freedom... Escape...

accept.text: A $r mage! How wonderous. I have not seen one of your kind for... oh what is it going on now? 500 years!$B$BI have something that will quench your thirst, but first you must do a task for me.$B$B<Lydros snickers.>$B$BThere is an anomaly in Eldre'Thalas. A water elemental has taken residence in the east wing. His presence must be catalogued!$B$BVenture to the Warpwood Quarter and extract a portion of the elemental essence of the Hydrospawn. Return it to me and I shall teach you a useful cantrip.

complete.text: Wonderful! Who are you again? Oh it matters not. What was I supposed to give you? Hrm... well you are a $c, perhaps you will find this useful.

objectives.text: Travel to the Warpwood Quarter of Dire Maul and slay the water elemental, Hydrospawn. Return to Lorekeeper Lydros in the Athenaeum with the Hydrospawn Essence.

progress.text: Yes? Do I know you?

complete.text:
You have done well, $N.  This web holds within it vast stores of the magic of Dire Maul, and I fear what damage may be unleashed if those energies were harnessed by one so irresponsible as Lethtendris.  I am saddened by her death, but I know that she could never part with her web while alive.

Thank you, $N.  I will send the web to students of magic more responsible than Lethtendris.  They will be the new wardens of its power.

Valennia only sent one person to help repel a full-scale assault... by the winds.

You don't look like much but I'll take what I can get. We need to inflict as much damage as possible to stop this soon. My people can't hold out much longer.

Go down the hill and disrupt their logistics. Their healers are keeping the attackers coming, if we take them out we might be able to rally and push them back. Any other cultists you kill while you are out there are helpful as well.

complete.text: You are still alive? Thank the winds for small miracles, I suppose.

objectives.text: Slay 4 Al'Aketh Healers and 8 Al'Aketh Brawlers in the Gustberry Lowlands.

accept.text:
There is a turncoat amongst the Al'Aketh. They claim to know the cult's true intentions for the island and want to come in, but will only do so with assurances of protection.

This defector is hiding at a secluded residence just northwest of Valanaar inside the highlands. I need someone who can discreetly go there, find the traitor, and escort him back to us. This might be a trap, but if this information is as important as this traitor claims, it's worth some risk.

complete.text: <This man is clearly dead, killed by the assassins that you fought outside the house. As you kneel down to inspect the body you notice the glinting reflection of something shiny...>

objectives.text: Find the cultist turncoat at the house just inside the highlands northwest of Valanaar.

accept.text: <You reach beneath the still-warm body of the turncoat cultist and recover a small, glowing blue crystal. It appears to be damaged, but it may still be important. High Elder Shadowsong may be interested in this.>

complete.text:
The turncoat was already dead when you arrived, you say? This is unfortunate news.

<You hand over the crystal you found on the dead cultist's body.>

Interesting...

objectives.text: Deliver the glowing crystal to Talanaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

progress.text: You are back? And... alone?

accept.text:
This attack is going to be hard to repel unless we can take out the cult commander. Belguilos "the Breaker" they call her, and she's a veritable terror. She used to be a peacekeeper before the cult got out of control, and even then she was... off. As a cultist I can only imagine how much worse she could be now.

I might just be sending you to your death, but someone needs to take Belguilos out if we are going to survive here. You can find her at the villa at the hill's base. Good luck, $c.

complete.text:
Belguilos is dead? Four winds bless you, $c. 

We might just make it out of this alive after all.

objectives.text: Slay Commander Belguilos in the Gustberry Lowlands.

complete.text:
When I said the bloodier the better, you really listened. Good. It lets me know you made it hurt.

On a serious note, thank you for what you've done so far. I've been floating aimlessly around this farm for weeks as if I was just waiting for the end to come. I think I'm starting to have hope again.

Ferauu and his thugs are due any time now. All that's left is to go out and face them. What do you say, will you see this through to the end with me?

progress.text:
If you manage to bring me enough bandit masks, maybe I'll stitch a blanket out of them and give it to Ferauu.

<Aamelia laughs loudly.>

accept.text:
You've done a lot to give us a fighting chance. Even if we die today, we'll at least know we gave it our best shot.

This is your last chance, stranger. If you want to head back to Valanaar and live another day, I wouldn't blame you.

On the other hand, if you really have a thing for lost causes just let me know when you are ready to go. We'll walk out there with our heads held high and whatever happens, happens.

complete.text: I... can't believe it's over. I need to stop and calm myself before my heart leaps right out of my chest.

objectives.text: Speak with Aamelia Windfield when you are ready to confront the bandit leader.

accept.text:
I guess it doesn't feel quite right to keep calling you stranger after all of this so... thank you, $n. 

If you wouldn't mind and are back out that way, please let Alvarion know what happened here. Also, tell him that once he's up on his feet he needs to bring a windshaper back here to look at that construct for us to make sure it's safe to have around our... our family.

<Aamelia touches her belly gently.>

He doesn't know about this part. Let's just keep that bit between us for now.

complete.text:
<Alvarion's eyes tear up as you finish retelling the story of what happened at the orchard.>

I don't know how to thank you, friend. I came to Valanaar looking for hope. A vain hope, I was almost certain. But instead I found a hero. A real hero, like the stories from before we came to Skywall. 

I'll never forget what you did for us, $N. You'll always be welcome at the Windfield home.

objectives.text: Speak with Alvarion Windfield in Valanaar.

accept.text:
When the cult began their campaign of violence, the Peacekeepers and Windshapers responded with posturing. I saw this as foolish escalation so I advocated for peaceful dialogue. Yesterday I dispatched my friend Belathaan Brightwish to the Shrine of Akir, hoping to establish that dialogue.

A box just arrived containing Belathaan's tongue, dipped in silver pigment. 

It's clear to me now that there is no reasoning with the cult. Kill any cultists you see, and bring me the prayer charms that they carry.

complete.text:
The High Order prides ourselves in our pragmatism and logic, and logic dictates that the avoidance of conflict and loss of life is the most prudent option in most situations.

<Elaadrin's eyes begin to glow and crackle with arcane energy.>

...however, the cult mistook our prudence for weakness and they are not nearly ready to pay the cost of that error.

objectives.text: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Windstone Charms from Al'Aketh cultists found north of Valanaar at the Gustberry Fields or Shrine of Akir.

progress.text: I don't agree with the Windshapers often, but they were right to dismiss the idea of trying to engage peacefully with the Al'Aketh. My attempt to take the high road cost a dear friend his life and is a mistake I will have to live with for the rest of my days.

complete.text:
It would not have been my preference to spill Windshaper blood but the blame for this pointless conflict rests solely on their shoulders. We sought to peacefully gather information, and they responded with violence.

Unfortunately, word has spread and the Windshapers are already calling it a 'massacre'. They wouldn't dare to retaliate here in Valanaar, but they will certainly not forget.

$N, you have been of tremendous aid to the High Order. Thank you.

progress.text:
It's often difficult for me to establish a distinction between the Windshapers and the Al'Aketh, save that one is more overtly violent than the other. Equally slavish to their misplaced beliefs, they are both equally dangerous if left to their own devices.

They see our desire to better understand this realm and its magic as a desecration of their traditions. Their small-mindedness is why our mission is so important. If not us, who will have the courage to save Zephras?

accept.text:
The High Order have done our best to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but that is clearly no longer an option. Their hostility has been clearly demonstrated, and now there are rumors of larger-scale cult movements around the island. They are clearly gearing up for something and whatever it is can't be good for the people of Zephras.

Report to Valennia Stormfist and inform her that the High Order offers our full support in Valanaar's efforts against the Al'Aketh, should the need arise.

complete.text:
I am sorry to hear about Belathaan. He was actually my cousin and he was a good $c and servant of Zephras. We will avenge him.

You seem eager to lend aid immediately. Come, let's speak further on the current situation.

objectives.text: Report to Valennia Stormfist and let her know that the High Order is with them in their fight against the Al'Aketh.

accept.text:
I suspect it will take a bit of time for us to mop up what's left of the attackers, but our chances are far better now. Head back to Valanaar and let them know that we are stable here now.

I can't thank you enough for your help. We'd be in much worse shape without you. I asked for reinforcements and it seems that I got a burgeoning hero instead. I'll take that.

May the four winds bless you, $c.

complete.text:
<Valennia looks visibly relieved as you tell her about the status of the eastern watchtower.>

Thank the winds.

objectives.text: Bring Yorna's Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.

accept.text:
The attacks on both the western and eastern watchtowers are not a coincidence. Based on what you told us about what occurred at the western watchtower with that skypriest, our best guess is that the cult is trying to do something to the anchor pylons.

Please speak with High Elder Shadowsong. He will tell you about a lead that could prove to be promising.

complete.text: I have a small matter that requires just the kind of assistance that an adventurer like yourself can provide.

objectives.text: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

accept.text:
<You approach the strange crystal, guarded mere moments ago by emaciated mana elementals.

Its pedestal, though ancient, is noticeably less dilapidated than the elven ruins it is built upon.

A weak hum of power radiates from the fractured gemstone, but with its magic so heavily depleted its purpose will ultimately remain a mystery for the time being.

Perhaps there is more to discover nearby.>

complete.text:
To hear that the crystal within the temple shines brightly is an immense weight off my shoulders. I was worried that the centaur had breached the temple grounds now, too. It would seem they continue to be off-put by what's inside.

As for the other pylons, if elementals are still standing vigilant over them, then they are quite capable of being restored.

I hope the temple's denizens didn't frighten you. They are friendly enough, just bitter. Understandably bitter.

objectives.text: Explore Shen'dralas in an effort to find other pylons like the one you found.

accept.text:
Everyone is here, good. I've just sent a few of my best fighters in through the front of the shrine to cause a bit of trouble and serve as a distraction, while I lead the the bulk of our forces in from the flank.

If all goes well, we should be able to punch through quickly and take out the High Priestess. As for you, get in there and start cracking skulls. Meet my second, Hyusaa Quickbreeze, near the steps to the shrine after you've caused some trouble.

Winds guide you, $c.

complete.text: We fought hard to get this far but it isn't over yet.

objectives.text: Slay $1oa Al'Aketh Guardians, $2oa Al'Aketh Spiritcallers, and $3oa Al'Aketh Blademasters, then report to Hyusaa Quickbreeze at the Shrine of Akir.

accept.text:
You will have to forgive me for sending you on such a series of tasks without providing any context. I hadn't considered how suspicious this may have seemed, more so now that the skies have taken on such a dramatic appearance.

I will gladly answer your questions.

complete.text:
I hope that explanation alleviated any concerns you might have had, $N. As you see, I was not acting out of any foul intent, and my failure to explain the situation thoroughly from the start was purely due to my enthusiasm of having a chance to see the crystals' lights shine again.

I am excited to visit the temple of Shen'dralas again, though it may take some time before I muster the courage to speak with the Shen'dralar there.

You, on the other hand...

objectives.text: Speak with Mordent Evenshade in Shen'dralas for information about the crystals you repaired.

accept.text: The Peacekeepers are mobilizing and we are all gearing up to head out. Make whatever preparations you need to make and meet us at the eastern road leading north out of town. We'll have one final check-in with everyone before we move out.

complete.text: We are as ready as we'll ever be.

objectives.text: Speak with Valennia Stormfist in the Gustberry Lowlands.

accept.text:
Please extend my thanks to Elaadrin for all that the High Order and your new friends from this "Kirin Tor" have done for Zephras Isle. I'm aware of the High Order's plans to leave the island, and your order has my blessing and well-wishes in this expedition.

I can only hope that whatever arcane solution the High Order finds can truly provide us with the stability we've lacked these past years. If you plan to go with them... well, this mission will be all the stronger for it.

Winds be with you, $n.

objectives.text: Speak with Elaadrin Evengale when you are prepared to leave Zephras Isle.

accept.text:
Uh, um... h-hello, I mean to say, hi! Greetings, even! I'm sorry... it's um, been so long since I've actually spoken to another person. I'm afraid I'm a bit rusty at this.

<The strange hooded figure shifts uncomfortably before you.>

So er, um... how is your day going?

complete.text:
...that's about all I have to say about it. I was--um--somewhere else before I was here. Now I'm here and I have my friends, and my things. T-things I built, I mean. That's about all I need. I think that's all I need, anyway.

I have to say though, it is nice to talk to someone who will talk back. The forest spirits try, but they just end up singing at me. That's nice in its own way, but not exactly s-stimulating conversation.

objectives.text: Speak with the Strange Hermit in the Shadowgale Forest and learn more about him.

accept.text:
I do appreciate you stopping by to talk with me! I-If you do want to help out, I could use a bit of help gathering up acorns from the forest floor. I've gathered most of the ones close by but there sure are a lot of raptor-bird things in the forest. It's dangerous out there and I'd rather not become a giant bird's lunch!

So if you want, you could maybe gather them for me? I'll make us something tasty if you do!

complete.text:
Thank you, stranger! You'll find that these are delicious once roasted! 

Please excuse me, it won't take me long to whip this up.

objectives.text: Gather $1oa Shadowgale Acorns in Shadowgale Forest.

progress.text: Mmm, I think you are going to like what I can cook up with these acorns!

accept.text:
The Al'Aketh have visited great tragedy upon our enclave, and blood must be repaid with blood.

I have an offer for you, stranger. Should you find conflict with these accursed cultists, bring me the ears of those you kill. I will reward you for each that you return with in both coin and, in time, access to the Nightclaw's secrets should you prove yourself to be a true friend.

complete.text:
Excellent work. Only good things can happen by eliminating the cult. Hopefully this sends a message that the Nightclaw are not to be trifled with and that our resentments run deep.

I suspect you have your work cut out for yourself, taking on the cult. If you gather more ears, bring them here.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Al'Aketh Cultist's Ears from the Al'Aketh cultists in Shadowgale Forest, the Shrine of Akir, or Gustberry Lowlands.

progress.text: I will not rest until my fangs have gone through the throat of every single cultist on this isle.

accept.text:
Most of the elves on this island seem to think that these woods are haunted, and they aren't wrong.

At the old ruins to the northeast, a strange type of ghost-like spirits gather. Some nights, you can almost hear them "singing". It's not like any song I've heard before, but it's definitely a song and it's... just so sad.

I'm not sure why, but I think something terrible happened there at some point, and the spirits are trapped there somehow. If you are feeling brave, maybe you can help set them free?

complete.text: Thank you, stranger.

objectives.text: Destroy 10 Wind Hollows in Shadowgale Forest.

accept.text:
It likely comes as no surprise to you that both of the centaur clans are hesitant to accept aid from anyone outside of their clan. This is especially true for folks like you and me - you know, non-centaurs.

One thing we all have in common is an understanding that money is power, and we have learned that the local centaur barter with carved wood. If you bring me a few samples of their designs, I can put in a rush order for similar etchings. Perhaps we can buy ourselves an advantage.

objectives.text: Acquire $1oa Carved Centaur Totems by slaying centaur of any clan throughout Desolace, then return them to Captain Pentigast at Nijel's Point.

complete.text:
Winds bless me, this meat looks fantastic! 

Thank you so much, $c.

progress.text:
Windsong Crawler meat is common enough here but it was something of a delicacy on the islands of Anvilas and Siroccas. Was a time, back when the skystreams were open that the locals would mob me for the stuff when I'd make the trip to Shen'dramar or New Eldre'naar.

Not been able to visit those places in... well... a long time.

accept.text:
I've just received word that the cult is attacking the pylon watchtower just outside of town! I've sent the few extra peacekeepers we have here to try and break through the enemy back line to relieve the defenders, but any additional help could mean the difference between our people there living or dying.

Please leave immediately for the east watchtower and provide whatever aid you can.

My lieutenant Yorana Windyreed led the relief force. If she still lives she can tell you how best to help.

complete.text: We are holding them off for now, but they have greater numbers and our fighters are starting to get tired. We need to do something to break the stalemate, and do it fast.

objectives.text: Report to Yorana Windyreed at the eastern watchtower in the Gustberry Lowlands.

accept.text:
As the garden's caretaker, it was my responsibility to ensure it thrived.

I knew there would come a day when I could no longer maintain it, so I enchanted a necklace gifted from my daughter to transform a new generation of saplings into treants, so they could watch over the garden in my stead. I placed it on an enchanted pedestal, sheltered within a small shrine.

The garden was in great hands. I must know what happened.

complete.text:
<Mithera listens quietly to your explanation of the situation.>

The pedestal is empty? My necklace is... missing?

<A great sadness washes over her expression.>

I should have expected as much. The quilboar and the centaur have been ravaging these lands for such a short amount of time, but the damage they have already done is immeasurable.

$N, even if the magic is gone from the necklace, I am clinging onto hope that I may have it back. Would you be willing to help?

objectives.text: Investigate the Forlorn Gardens near Shen'dralas and then return to Mithera at the nearby temple.

accept.text:
I suspect your curiosity is luring you toward the grand structure now, yes? Good!

The Shen'dralar there are unlikely to welcome you with open arms, but so long as you tread respectfully, I do not think you will run into any trouble.

With any luck, my old friend Kirandis might be easy to find. Of everyone, he is the most likely to be amicable to your presence.

complete.text:
It is remarkable to see that the pylons' power burns brightly once more. I am surprised I hadn't noticed before you arrived. I was beginning to think that this one would soon suffer the same fate, and we would be lost to time.

Thank you for tethering us back in full to Shen'dralas. Try to meet some of our denizens. They may be wary of you, but that will pass.

objectives.text: Locate Magister Kirandis inside the temple of Shen'dralas.

accept.text:
I am the ancient. Towering above us. That which still burns despite many rains. I feel its flames in death. Forever burdened by my last mistake.

I do not know why I am cursed to haunt this place. I do not understand why death was not the end.

Please put out the flame. Seek pristine water from a sacred ravine. Such a place exists across Mashan'she. I have heard murmurs of the place in the wind.

Maraudon.

complete.text:
<The flames that previously burned away at the treant's ghostly form have faded. Still, his gaze is hollow. It takes several moments of inaction before he regards your presence.>

My torment has ended. Peace approaches me.

No time for farewells. No time to wait for those that have forgotten me.

Traveler, I have one final thing to say. One last hope for your quest.

objectives.text: Venture to Maraudon and recover a Vial of Earth Song Water and return it to Woodwyrd at the Forlorn Gardens in Desolace.

progress.text: <Woodwyrd stands, nearly motionless. He stares through you, just as you once might have stared through the ghosts of Shen'dralas.>

complete.text:
Where did you say you found this? I'm surprised you're still fully intact. Thanks, kid.

Y'know. If you're in the habit of doin' favors, I bet plenty of folk 'round here will have a use for ya. Why don'tcha stick around for a bit?

progress.text: <Vayn nods at you.>

accept.text:
Windstones are a critical resource on Zephras Isle as they contain the raw, concentrated energy of the winds themselves. The wind elementals who used to live here on Zephras with us vanished a number of years ago, and since then, the magic that sustains this island is slowly fading. Not without limitations, the windstones are still a reliable energy source, and are incredibly valuable to us.

You'll find raw windstones scattered around the grove. Think you can help me harvest them?

objectives.text: Collect 15 Windstone Clusters from Raw Windstones in Thendal Grove.

accept.text:
<You hold a grimy collar retrieved from the belly of a slain creature. The material is of a high-quality leather, clearly stitched with care.

A tag dangles from a corroded buckle. You swipe away the gunk and can see Thalassian text, though the letters are stylized beyond readability, perhaps even to those familiar with the language.

Now, you are presented with a choice. Do you disregard this and move on with your life, or do you attempt the impossible and seek to bring closure to its owner?>

complete.text:
This belonged to Dahlia, my best friend and favorite feline. Dahlia... I never was creative with names. It fit her though, she was a vibrant, blooming flower in my life.

The origin of it isn't very exciting. I was passing by some dahlia flowers in the garden when this little kitten leapt out at me! So playfully menacing. She followed me back to the temple and... that was that!

No need to stick around while I reminisce. Here's something for your trouble, thank you for resurfacing some old memories.

objectives.text: Return the Partially Digested Collar to someone who knows about it. Presumably, they can be found in or near Shen'dralas in Desolace.

progress.text: <Liranne takes the collar and inspects it. She gently cradles the metal tag in her other hand, and flashes a brief smile upon reading it.>

accept.text:
<With a terrible crunch, you removed a piece of the worm's carapace upon its demise.

Despite its enormous size and hefty weight, it is disappointingly ordinary. This creature was seemingly not the result of a cruel experiment nor carefully bred to be an all-devouring beast.

It is simply an impressive shell, likely desired only by collectors. Perhaps you could find one, though other than the centaur, who else might be alive around here?>

complete.text:
<The quilboar's eyes dart over toward the carapace jutting out from your backpack. He snorts once. Twice. Three times even, before pulling his blade away.>

Big Worm dead?

Big Worm dig through Bristleback land. Eat our dead. Devour our young.

Big worm dead. Big $R hero of Bristleback. Big $R allowed in quilboar land. For now.

What Big $R want?

objectives.text: Find someone interested in Corpsefeeder's Carapace.

progress.text: <Kog'thug has a blade to your throat before you manage to say a word.>

accept.text:
Among the treants borne of the necklace, one in particular stood above all the others to have received the gift of life and sentience. I suspect if they have fallen, he may be the only one that remains.

He spent his days tending to each and every bloom and bud, and his evenings rooted in the ground to serve as a nest for the smaller critters.

If he is alive, and I pray that to be true, then he may know what happened.

I am holding out hope for my good friend, Woodwyrd.

complete.text:
It is too late. For these gardens.

I am the last of my generation of caretakers. Without the gift, more cannot take my place.

The weeds have overtaken the land. The flowers are restless. The trees wither.

<Woodwyrd slowly turns toward the towering ancient illuminating the sky with its endless fire.>

objectives.text: Find Woodwyrd in the Forlorn Gardens at Shen'dralas in the Desolace.

accept.text:
If you wish to recover the woman's gift, march north into the Valley of Bones.

It was stolen. The quilboar are to blame. I saw it. With my own two eyebulbs.

They are why this garden is doomed to die.

Do not forgive them.

complete.text:
Big $R want necklace? Well, Big $R can't have!

Thornweavers need necklace. Land is deader than dead. Thorns no sprout without necklace! Centaur tread where thorns no sprout. See problem, or Big $R blind?

<Kog'thug pauses his condescending ramble and snorts thoughtfully.>

Kog'thug have idea. Want trade?

objectives.text: Seek out a quilboar of significance at the Bristleback Retreat.

accept.text:
Big $R heard of Razorfen Downs? <Snort.> Of course not! Big place in Barrens. Lots of thorns. Can't miss it.

Agamaggan died there. Important place for all quilboar. Now bristleback not allowed. Belong to sniffle-snorting Razorfen. Razorfen disrespect quilboar history!

Agamaggan's blood feeds the valley. Grow thorns. BIG ones. Bigger than puny elf necklace ever could!

Go to the Downs. Fetch Kog'thug blood. Stale blood from the kraul won't work. Need GOOD blood!

Give blood, get necklace, win.

objectives.text: Venture to Razorfen Downs and acquire Virulent Blood of Agamaggan, then return it to Kog'thug the Brave at Bristleback Retreat in the Desolace. Kog'thug felt it worth reminding that the Blood of Agamaggan inside Razorfen Kraul would not be sufficient.

accept.text:
<Found near Shen'dralas, this dirty old tome no longer holds most of its knowledge.

Of the text that remains, individual letters are difficult to distinguish from words. It may prove challenging to read at first, but one of them appears to be a surname.

Perhaps its author, "Evenshade", may be found nearby.>

objectives.text: The text suggests the author of this journal may be somewhere in Shen'dralas.

complete.text:
Thank you, $N. I can indeed feel the elemental energies in this bough waiting to be harnessed by those that have the gift to do so. This will make an excellent spell focus.

Did this branch sing to you, perhaps? It has often been the case that the branch picks the $c, and not the other way around.

<Belann chuckles as he gently takes the bough from you.>

progress.text:
Every year that passes in Zephras sees fewer and fewer of those who are gifted with a talent for magic. 

I am glad to see young mages such as yourself participate in our oldest traditions to help keep our history and culture alive and well.

accept.text:
Lorthuna fled up to the spires above using some sort of portal. Ayessa and Elaadrin went in after her. That was just a few moments ago.

I'm afraid I took one too many hits and this is where I stay. Go through the portal, find Elaadrin and help them stop Lorthuna.

Unless that help that Elaadrin and Ayessa said they sent for arrives soon, you are on your own from here. Good luck, $c.

complete.text:
I sent a few of our remaining mages to ensure that Valennia and her forces were able to escape as well. She should be resting at High Elder Shadowsong's residence now.

Ansirem had to return to Azeroth, but he and I discussed the next steps for the High Order before he departed. We survived the day, but Zephras is dangerously vulnerable now and we must make plans for what is to come.

objectives.text: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with High Priestess Lorthuna.

accept.text:
Valennia's forces just breached the inner sanctum. The fighting was thick in there at first, but it's grown... unsettlingly quiet. Go in there and do your best to link up with Valennia and her forces... if any of them are left.

I'll stay here and watch your back.

complete.text: <Valennia looks gravely wounded.>

objectives.text: Speak with Valennia Stormfist inside the inner sanctum at the Shrine of Akir.

accept.text:
Ansirem has told me much of the elemental lords and I am afraid that we have good reason to fear Al'Akir now that the wards that have hidden Zephras are down. If the Windlord chooses to attack us, we stand no chance to defend ourselves while we are here in his domain.

High Elder Shadowsong needs to know of the danger we are in, and more importantly, what our intentions are for our mission to Azeroth. We will find the means to save our home. I swear it.

complete.text:
<Talaanis Shadowsong listens intently as you tell him of what transpired above the Shrine of Akir, and of Elaadrin's plan to leave Zephras Isle.>

I need to reflect on this further, but looking at the upside, we have rid ourselves of Lorthuna and deprived the cult of their leader. Our home has not been invaded yet, and on the timeline of elemental demigods, it could be years... decades even, before Al'Akir deigns to turn his attention to us.

There is much to fear now, but much to celebrate as well.

objectives.text: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

accept.text:
Greetings, young $n. I oftentimes come here to look upon the ancient anchor pylon. Gifts from the spirits of the winds, they bind and sustain our island. Of late however, their magic has grown unstable and inconsistent.

They suffer no distress I can see. Their splendor has not changed.

If you'd like, I can lend you my gift to look upon them yourself.

complete.text: Thank you for taking a moment to share this with me. I will continue to watch over the grove, and ponder on the state of our homeland.

objectives.text: Speak with Halaan Hawk-Eye and borrow his gift to view the anchor pylon in the distance.

complete.text:
Thank goodness our message got to Lotheluum. Wait, where are the rest of the reinforcements? Surely it is not just you they sent?

<Elegael pales as you relay your conversation with Lotheluum.>

So the message did not get through. We are in dire straits indeed then.

It seems we must handle this on our own. Time is of the essence.

accept.text:
If we are to save my fellows in the Nightclaw Den, I am going to need some ingredients for a poultice. The first and most important is a spindly moss called Lady's Tear. It typically grows on the base of the trees here in Shadowgale.

This moss secretes a sticky substance that acts as an antiseptic and is perfect for binding open wounds. I have gathered what little I can reach but I know there is more in this forest.

Go and be swift. We are going to need a lot if the injured I left behind still live.

complete.text:
<Elegael takes the sticky mound of moss from you with a weak smile.>

Thank you, $N, you have done well. This is exactly what we need.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Lady's Tear Moss.

progress.text: Have you found the Lady's Tear?

accept.text:
The other ingredient I need for the poultice is feathers from the Shadowgale shrieklings that roam this forest. In their juvenile form, the shrieklings have insulative feathers which would be ideal to put over the moss. These feathers will prevent the antiseptic sap from drying out and will provide at least some protection against the elements.

Be warned, the shrieklings are normally docile but they have been incredibly hostile of late. Their large talons can easily disembowel you if you aren't careful.

complete.text: Thank you for these. I will be sure to use every feather so their sacrifice will not be in vain.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa feathers from the Shadowgale Shrieklings in Shadowgale Forest.

progress.text: It deeply saddens me to ask you to kill the young shrieklings, but with the rise in their aggression it is for the best. We can only handle so many emergencies at a time.

accept.text:
The Al'Aketh Cultists ambushed us with no warning, though their motives remain a mystery to me. I knew these cultists had clouds between their ears, but I never imagined they would upset the delicate balance here on Zephras with such brutality. Go, slay as many as you can and take their heirlooms if they wear any.

<Elegael spits.>

These storm-cursed cultists don't deserve to be called shen'dorei. The beasts of the forest can have their bodies. Their ashes don't deserve the winds.

complete.text:
<Elegael looks down at the collection of bloodied heirlooms with distress.>

So many young lives with so much potential now gone forever. Thank you for returning these, $c.

I will hold onto them for safekeeping until I am able to take them to the High Elder. There they can go back into the collection and await the next and perhaps more worthy generation to come of age.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Bloodied Heirlooms from Al'Aketh Footsoldiers and Al'Aketh Stormchasers in the Shadowgale Forest.

progress.text: I will make the cult pay for every drop of druid blood they have spilled this day.

accept.text:
The reason for cultists' presence here still baffles me, but I smell a familiar scent over the bloodshed.

One of our circle druids, Haalien, disappeared months back. It appears he's thrown his sorry hide in with the cultists.

Show him what happens when he spills the blood of his kin! Take his head and return it to me.

complete.text:
<Elegael grimaces at the severed head, but nods curtly.>

Thank you, $N. No matter how much rage I have within me, it would have been difficult to strike down my own cousin.

Do not mourn for him. His ignorance and malice has killed many innocents this day.

objectives.text: Kill Commander Haalien and bring his head to Elegael Thornpaw in the Shadowgale Forest.

progress.text: Are our brethren's lives truly worth so little to you, Haalien?

accept.text:
I have finished the poultices. Quickly, take them to the druids in the cave, north just across the clearing. I know my brethren are in much more dire condition than I. They are likely too injured to heal their own wounds. There are so few of us shen'dorei druids that every life is precious.

Before you go, I have a selfish request. My mate, Jorel Windsinger was in dire condition when I left. Please, see to his wounds if he still lives.

complete.text:
<Elegael's face pales as you relay the fate of Jorel and the condition of the rest of the druids.>

No... no! This is far worse than I had--

<Elegael chokes back a sob and grits her teeth, letting out a pained snarl.>

They will pay. They will ALL pay. Anyone who allies with the Al'Aketh will feel my wrath! This I swear.

objectives.text: Enter the Nightfang Den and heal $1oa druids and find Jorel Windsinger in Shadowgale Forest.

accept.text: <Tucked behind one of Haalien's bracers is a note that's been slightly torn and bloodstained in your fight. It looks like it contains useful information about the cultist motivations for the attack on the druid den. Elegael would be interested in this intel.>

complete.text:
They were here for the pylon? But to what end? We were not the original reason for their attack?

<Elegael trails off shaking with rage as she reads.>

They murdered my people because we were an inconvenience! I shall tear apart every cultist with my fangs! I will make sure none leave this place with their lives.

Go, swiftly! If the orders truly originated in Valanaar, it means it is likely a traitor hiding there. Give the missive to Lotheluum in Valanaar and tell him what has transpired.

objectives.text: Bring the Ripped Missive to Elegael Thornpaw in the Shadowgale Forest.

accept.text:
It would appear that there is a correspondent hiding somewhere in Valanaar feeding information to the cult. I am clearly in no shape to make the journey, but Lotheluum needs to know what transpired here.

He should also know the fate of those who are no longer with us. Thanks to your help I think we can handle the rest of the situation from here, though the damage has been done.

Please go swiftly, $n. I hope our paths will cross again someday. Until then, I have cultists to slay.

objectives.text: Give the missive to Lotheluum in Valanaar and tell him what has transpired.

accept.text:
The turncoat clearly was afraid of what the cult had planned, enough so to defect and seek our aid. It's truly unfortunate that he is dead and took his secrets to the grave with him.

We must discuss this further to determine our next steps.

complete.text:
We could try and send peacekeepers to directly engage the cult forces, but we would not fare well against them in open battle.

We are going to need a different approach.

objectives.text: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong and observe the conversation.

complete.text: Big man himself sent you, huh? You come to help out, or just to hound me for horses like the last fella?
Pest control's an important part of any farmer's job. I appreciate your help.

accept.text:
I've got no idea what happened to our horses. I got up one morning to feed 'em and they were all gone, just like that.

Life outside Farholde's a bit rougher. Anything could've got 'em--animals, murlocs, orcs, you name it.

If we wanna narrow down our list of culprits, we oughta search around the stables for clues.

complete.text: I knew it! It's those dang coyotes!

objectives.text: Search near the stables at Wheeler's Grange for evidence of the missing horses' whereabouts.

progress.text: I'm itching just as much as ol' Demar to find out what happened to the horses. They're how I make my living, after all.

accept.text:
There's a pack of coyotes livin' in a den west of here. We can see 'em sometimes from across the river. They used to hunt fish on the shore, but I guess the murlocs pushed 'em out of their usual feeding ground, and so they've taken to eating horses.

The leader of the coyote pack's a bigger one with dark fur. We'd nicknamed him "Sootfur". I reckon if you kill him, the rest'll scatter.

complete.text:
<Benjy looks into the face of Sootfur's pelt.>

Well well well, that'll teach ya not to go rootin' around in my stables!

<Benjy looks back to you.>

You did good, $N. When we're up and running again, it'll be nice to know our horses'll be safe.

objectives.text: Kill the coyote known as Sootfur, and bring its pelt back to Benjy Wheeler.

progress.text: I'm gonna make a hat out of that varmint, I'll tell you what!

accept.text:
From what you found, it seems like the coyotes got most of the horses. Still, there's a few not accounted for.

Those that didn't get eaten probably ran off scared someplace. I don't know how many of those horses there are, but we'd better find 'em before the coyotes come back.

<Benjy holds out a sack in front of you.>

Here. If you find one, give it some of our feed. That'll get it to trust you so you can lead it back here.

objectives.text: Find one of the horses that fled Wheeler's Grange after the coyote attack and give it some feed.

accept.text:
The gnolls have been a thorn in our side ever since we arrived. While less a threat than the Twilight's Hammer, they are aggressive, persistent and, worst of all, numerous.

The hills beyond this post are infested with them, making passage to the north dangerous, and posing a threat to those living outside the walls of Farholde Keep.

If we are ever to make these lands safe, removing the gnoll threat is imperative.

complete.text:
Is that gnoll spittle on you? No matter. Under any other circumstance I'd question where that came from, but this--

<Cedric motions up and down your frame with his hand.>

This is what we do out here.

objectives.text: Kill $1oa Redridge Mystics, $2oa Redridge Trappers, and $3oa Redridge Brutes for Cedric Dalton at Southern Watch.

accept.text:
Gnolls value strength above all else. By killing their strongest, we not only lessen the threat they pose physically, but also strike fear into their hearts.

In a den among the Bristle Hills is a notorious gnoll by the name of Snargl. His death would no doubt sow panic among the Redridge's ranks.

Bring me his snout, and be quick about it.

objectives.text: Locate Snargl in the Bristle Hills, kill him, and bring his snout to Cedric Dalton at Southern Watch.

progress.text: Is that vermin dead yet?

accept.text:
We make our own fertilizer out here. It's a special formula of mine that reeks like hell, but grows trees like they're weeds.

It's a 1:1:2 ratio of crawfish shells, manure, and murloc heads. Tasty, right?

The manure's easy enough. We've got the ranch to the south for that. The heads and shells? Those you're going to have to go wading in the river for.

If you feel like lending a hand, we could sure use your help getting some fertilizer ingredients.

complete.text: I knew you were coming this way by the smell. I appreciate you getting your hands dirty for us, so to speak. Now, go wash up in the river before we get to planting some trees.

objectives.text: Gather 4 Jumbo Crawfish Shells, 4 pieces of Fresh Manure, and 8 Mudfin Murloc Heads for Halligan Turner.

progress.text: Some folks think lumber work's a simpleton's job. They'd be dead wrong. Having skills like botany and chemistry can get you far in this business.

accept.text:
Considering you got yourself wrist-deep in guts and manure for us, it's only right you get to do the fun part too.

The boys and I gather seeds from the trees as we work. With the fertilizer you've provided, I've made a planting kit to put them in the ground to grow new saplings.

Take it, and find some good planting spots around the work sites.

complete.text: Nothing like a hard day's work, eh $N? Good on you for helping out.

objectives.text: Plant 5 saplings around the lumber camp with Halligan Turner's tree sprouting kit.

progress.text: We grow 'em up, cut 'em down, and grow 'em back up again. It's a beautiful cycle.

accept.text:
Stranger, listen to me!

I work as a lumberjack for the nearby logging camp. As you can see, I've been trapped here in an accident. If I don't get out from here soon, I'll either bleed out, or be eaten by wild animals.

Please, go to the logging camp and fetch help!

complete.text: My brother's where?!

objectives.text: Go to Turner's Logging Camp and get help.

accept.text:
Well, I guess that explains why Curly didn't come back for lunch break. Looks like I have to bail him out again -- typical. The way he makes me worry, I swear, I'll be gray in a year.

Come on, we'll have to save him ourselves, and it sounds like we don't have much time.

complete.text:
That damn kid...

Even if he is a knucklehead, Curly's a good worker. Hopefully he heals up fine and learns some sense. Things could've gone a lot worse if you hadn't been there. Thanks for looking out for him.

objectives.text: Go with Hurley to save Curly.

complete.text: You do your Alliance proud, $r. If the Stormwind aristocracy had even half your mettle, we'd have ended this war years ago.

This is a good start. But I believe these merely point to a larger prize.

In fact, Demar has news that may be of interest to us. Why don't you run along and speak to the good Knight Commander?

progress.text: The Twilight's Hammer are dogmatic, but hardly organized. You're likely to find their pages scattered throughout Sunnyglade.

complete.text: Excellent work, $c. I could feel the power you carry before you even entered the keep.

progress.text: You shouldn't have too much trouble finding charms off of Twilight's Hammer spellcasters. They seem to hoard them quite jealously.

accept.text:
The log is full of meticulous recordings on the comings and goings of Twilight's Hammer forces throughout the Riverglades. 

The author is nowhere to be found, but this information could help shed light on enemy movements.

Someone in Farholde will want to see this.

complete.text: These notes come too late, I'm afraid. We are now well aware of the dangers within Sunnyglade. What's more troubling is that you have found them.

objectives.text: Deliver the Field Marshal's Log to Demar Brant in Farholde Keep.

progress.text: What have you found?

accept.text:
As helpful as you've been here in Farholde, I believe your talents could be put to better use elsewhere.

A patrol of ours went missing some time ago. They were in charge of our western borders, but with the information Miss Amberhall has uncovered, I fear they walked right into the Twilight Hammer's central encampment.

We can handle the cleanup in Sunnyglade ourselves. If the good lady is right, it's critical that we check on our wayward sergeant. He could use all the help he can get.

complete.text: If you're here, Amberhall must be nagging the Knight Commander about our lack of reports. Don't let her sweet talk fool you, she'd sell your soul if she thought it was worth something.

objectives.text: Find Sergeant Riftan near the Twilight's Shroud to the west.

accept.text:
Field Marshal Ryan is one of our best. His keen eyes and reliable intel have been paramount to our war efforts.

His final reports refer to a Twilight's Hammer fortress to the west. Find him before it's too late. And take his logbook with you. It may offer more clues as to the whereabouts of our missing marshal.

objectives.text: Find Marshal Ryan within the Twilight's Shroud.

accept.text:
If Amberhall is so impatient for her report, it would have been nice if she sent more than one $c. Must be hard work hiding in her ivory tower.

Look, every attempt to contact Farholde Keep ends with our runners being captured by Twilight scouts. I can't afford to risk any more troops going into that fortress, but we can't keep my people imprisoned in there either.

You want us to return? Help me rescue my soldiers first. You should be able to find the keys to their cages off their champions' corpses.

objectives.text: Rescue $1oa Farholde Scouts within the Twilight's Shroud for Sergeant Riftan.

accept.text:
It seems every day the Twilight's Hammer are drawing more into their order, while we haven't heard so much as a word from Stormwind. Sooner or later we'll be overrun.

I don't care what a bureaucrat like Amberhall says. I'm not abandoning this position while an army amasses in our own homeland. If we leave now, we'll only have to deal with these cultists again later. Only next time, on our doorstep.

If your orders are to babysit me anyway, at least make yourself useful and help me cull these zealots.

objectives.text: Defeat $1oa Twilight Fanatics, $2oa Twilight Corrupters, and $3oa Twilight Champions within the Twilight's Shroud for Sergeant Riftan.

accept.text:
You've been such a good little $c for me, I wonder if I could ask you to do one more small favor.

With the reagents you collected being so finely attuned to Twilight's Hammer magic, they are perfect for a summoning ritual. However, we'll need to take them to the source of their power.

Should you happen upon a conduit while you're gallivanting about the Twilight's Shroud, see if you can't call upon one of the cult's thralls and capture it with this soulstone for me. For questioning, of course.

objectives.text: Summon a Twilight's Thrall from a conduit within the Twilight Shroud and capture it with Amberhall's Soulstone.

accept.text:
<Robbie leans in to talk to you, as if sharing a grave secret.>

Psst! Hey $gmister:miss;, I need your help!

My sister got me a hat for my birthday but I lost it playing in the river. I'm not allowed to be down there because of the murlocs so I can't ask Dad or Ellie for help because then they'll know where I was!

It's a good hat. I bet one of those murlocs found it and kept it for himself!

complete.text: My hat! Oh thank you, thank you, thank you mister! You're the best!

objectives.text: Find Robbie's Hat somewhere along the river near the murlocs.

progress.text: Ooh... Ellie's gonna be so mad if she finds out I lost that hat.

accept.text:
The orcish poachers are a bloodthirsty lot. They'll kill anything that moves--be it men, lions, or horses. They are a threat to all life in the Riverglades, and must be stopped.

They roam the plains in packs, like rabid animals. If you see any, put them down.

complete.text:
Cut down quite a few of them, eh? Perhaps you're not as soft as I first took you for.

I hope the buzzards are making a meal of those savages.

objectives.text: Kill 12 Rog'mar Poachers for Watcher Cornelius.

accept.text:
Farholde prides itself on its independence, but there are a few things we can only get through trade.

We've negotiated an arrangement with a dealer at Powderfuse Port. We provide her with goods that are dangerous to acquire, and she provides us with specialty munitions.

Currently, she's in the market for lion fur. A pride of them live atop a large hill in the center of the plains. If you'd like to make yourself useful, you could aid me in harvesting some of their hides.
