complete.text: Yes, these will do nicely. Let me package them up for you to deliver.

objectives.text: Bring 8 Prized Lion Hides to Watcher Terral.

progress.text: The lions hunt in packs, $c. Be careful not to get surrounded.

accept.text:
These hides are to be delivered to Powderfuse Port. It is a goblin-run port to the northeast.

When you get there, deliver the hides to Friz Frazzlespark. Tell her they're from Cornelius. The details of our trade have already been worked out, so she'll know what they are for.

complete.text:
Cornelius ain't delivering these himself anymore? Thank goodness! Couldn't stand that guy.

<Friz inspects the contents of the bundle.>

Looks satisfactory. Tell your people at Farholde to keep 'em comin'.

objectives.text: Deliver the Bundle of Lion Hides to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port.

progress.text: Whaddya got for me?

accept.text:
The boys up at Southern Watch do a good job keeping gnolls out for the most part. Every now and then a few sneak into the camp at night and cause a bit of trouble. They especially like to steal saw blades, which they likely use to make weapons out of the sharp metal.

If you could get some back for us, it'd be a big help. The gnolls have probably got 'em stashed away somewhere in their camps up in the hills to the west.

complete.text: Nicely done! Maybe I oughta hire you as security.

objectives.text: Recover $1oa Saw Blades from the gnoll camps in Bristle Hills for Halligan Turner at the lumber mill.

progress.text: Those saw blades aren't easy to come by. Any you can bring back would save us a great deal of time and resources.

accept.text:
<The gnoll pulls a bit of gold from his pocket and waves it at you.>

$R, I offer trade! There is more where this came from. Help me get revenge, and I will show you!

complete.text: Yes yes, very good! Now we get out of here and go to treasure.

objectives.text: Bring 20 Twilight Finger Bones to Fuzzle.

progress.text: Bring me fingers, *then* I show you treasure.

accept.text:
Come, $r. It is time to leave this place. If any try to stop us, we will tear them to shreds!

Once we are safe, I will take you to your reward.

objectives.text: <Fuzzle snarls.>

accept.text:
Oh! Sorry, I didn't see you there.

I was just putting together a little something for a friend of mine. Well... more of an acquaintance, really. Have you met Watcher Fredericks yet? He's stationed at Southern Watch just west of here.

He comes by the ranch on patrol every now and then. I thought it would be nice to give him a little something to show my appreciation.

I'd deliver it myself, but I need to keep an eye on my little brother and tend to the ranch.

I'm sure you understand.

complete.text:
Oh! Something from Eleanor? How kind of her!

<His cheeks flush a little.>

I'll have to return the favor sometime. Thank you for delivering this.

objectives.text: Deliver Eleanor's care package to Watcher Fredericks at Southern Watch.

progress.text: Something to report?

accept.text:
Time for a special delivery.

Knight Commander Demar Brant at Farholde is waiting for this. For some reason he always makes me say his full name. What an odd fella.

Anywho, you can find him holed up in the keep southwest of here. Massive stone fortress. Ya can't miss it.

complete.text: That goblin is nothing more than a means to an end. There are certain dealings that must be done to ensure the safety and success of our people.

objectives.text: Deliver Frazzlespark's Crate to Knight Commander Demar Brant in Farholde Keep.

accept.text:
The orcs have become an encroaching threat ever since their arrival. First, claiming the lands by the river and now their presence grows within the plains...

I'll never understand their kind, nor do I care, truth be told, but I'll be damned if they think there's more ground to be taken.

complete.text: It'll take some time to replenish their ranks. Perhaps now we can regain control of the area.

objectives.text: Kill $1oa Rog'mar Trainees for Watcher Cornelius at Terral's Watch.

accept.text:
The message we've delivered is clear.

Return to Brant within the keep and show him the report. I'm certain he'll be pleased with our progress.

complete.text:
It seems Cornelius has proven quite effective at his post, with your help, of course.

Unfortunately, celebration distracts from our remaining work, exposing us to unnecessary vulnerabilities, but... perhaps a moment to reflect on our progress is in order.

objectives.text: Deliver the report to Demar Brant in Farholde Keep.

accept.text:
Murlocs, murlocs, murlocs! That's all I ever hear about; from the sailors, the fishermen, even my own kids! Everyone's on my case about 'em! They're a nuisance, I admit, but I got a port to run here!

Help a guy out, would ya? Kill a couple 'a those things and I'll make it worth your time.

complete.text: You handled 'em? Good! I'm sure more'll be back soon, but at least I can get some peace and quiet until then.

objectives.text: Kill 8 Murloc Oracles and 8 Murloc Warriors along the Eastwind Shore.

accept.text:
You know the Eastsea crew? Real unsavory bunch, and that's coming from the guy running a place called "Powderfuse Port".

They're destructive, bloodthirsty, and, worst of all, cutting into my bottom line. They steal cargo, and sink ships, both of which end up costing me the big bucks!

We gotta take down their whole operation, starting with the ones closest to here. You can find 'em along the beaches to the north.

objectives.text: Kill $1oa Eastsea Buccaneers and $2oa Eastsea Musketeers along the Eastwind Shore, north of Powderfuse Port.

accept.text:
Sailors and swimmers beware! An especially aggressive murloc, nicknamed "Old Rot-Chum" by local fishermen, has been seen attacking rowboats and other small vessels in the waters to the south, near a collection of murloc-infested islands.

A reward is being offered by Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz in exchange for proof of the creature's demise.

objectives.text: Bring proof of Old Rot-Chum's demise to Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz.

accept.text:
Welcome to Fimbo's cafe on the water! Today's menu is roasted boar, and roasted fish...same as every day...

This menu needs a shake up, badly. I've had my eye on a new seafood stew recipe, but I'm gonna need some fresh meat. A few murloc eyes and some crab meat oughta do.

You can find both along the beaches nearby. Can't beat some good ol' fashioned local ingredients!

complete.text: Delectable cuts, my sous chef. One pot of seafood stew coming right up!

objectives.text: Gather 12 Murloc Eyes and 6 pieces of Sand Crawler Meat for Fimbo Greasemitz.

progress.text: The trick to murloc eyes is you gotta cook 'em real quick. That way, you can still taste the brine!

accept.text:
You... where did you come from? You shouldn't be here!

<Bolain struggles through the pain--bruised, battered, and a disease-ridden bite wound to his leg.>

Take this to Dalton. Head north up the road and east where the plains open wider than this gash in my damn leg. I'd tell you to tell him he was right, but I won't give him that satisfaction... at least not until after I'm dead.

I hate these damn hills!

complete.text:
Bolain went where?? That son of a--I told him not to go alone.

It seems some of our own still underestimate those damn gnolls. The knight commander will want to hear of this at once.

objectives.text: Deliver Bolain's message to Captain Dalton at Southern Watch.

accept.text:
As much as I'd like to deliver the blood-soaked message to the knight commander himself, I'd also like to keep my post. I've cleaned it up a bit so it's less... well, bloody.

Given the recent gnoll uprisings, I'm afraid the task of delivering the news falls upon you.

complete.text:
It is unfortunate news, but it is no surprise. For years the gnoll presence has riddled these lands.

When we first arrived the battles raged throughout the hills and lower plains in constant skirmishes. Only after many losses were we able to recover and hold our ground.

I'll see to it Dalton and his men receive additional rations, weapons, and for the time being, footmen. We can't risk the gnolls breaching our territory again.

objectives.text: Deliver the Southern Watch Gnoll Report to the knight commander at Farholde Keep.

complete.text: We'll get a few new targets fixed up right away.

progress.text: Find what you were looking for?

accept.text:
The rigors of training for battle are one thing, but these trainees don't yet understand the difference between a training sword and the well-kept blade of a seasoned veteran.

I think it's time we show our recruits how a sharpened blade can be the difference between victory and death.

If you can find us a few sharpening stones, we'll put them to good use. There are certain craftsmen known to study this trade. I'd suggest starting there.

objectives.text: Bring $1oa Solid Sharpening Stones to Ember Bladewhisper at the Farholde training grounds.

accept.text:
Calling all anglers!

I'm in the market for some crab meat. Not just the usual shreds either, I'm talking whole claw. I've seen a big one crawling around under the docks, stealing bait and cutting lines.

I'll pay a reward to anyone who brings me that thing's pincer. You'll also get a helping of the dish I whip up.

-- Fimbo Greasemitz

objectives.text: Bring Trapclaw's Pincer to Fimbo Greasemitz.

progress.text: What's the word, $r?

accept.text:
The hide is painted with broad strokes of fish guts and squid ink. It appears to depict some kind of sea monster, rising up from the waves, with a long neck. What could this beast be?

The nearest port is Powderfuse Port. If this monster is real, and lurks these waters, a sailor there has surely seen it.

complete.text: Sea monster...? Wait! So you've <hic> seen it too!?

objectives.text: Find someone at Powderfuse Port who can identify the monster from the painted hide.

accept.text:
That monster...with the long neck, just like you said. I've seen 'im around those islands -- out on my boat. I tried <hic> tellin' folks, but ohh nooo, you can't <hic> believe ol' Argo. He's just some...some...drunkard fisherman! Makin' up stories!

We'll show 'em...soon as I get some bait...

Hey! Quit standin' around! I'm gonna need entrails, a LOT of 'em. Any beast from around here. The smellier <hic> the better. I'm also gonna need some Rotflesh mushrooms. Those grow in that cave by Windstead.

complete.text:
<Argo throws a hand over his mouth in reaction to the smell.>

Ugh...great work skipper. Now <hic> put those away before I get sick again...

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Beast Entrails and $2oa Rotflesh Mushrooms for Argo Brinewhistle.

progress.text: When we catch that thing...oh ho...no one'll be laughing at ol' Argo then!

accept.text:
The last part's <hic> easy...just take that big ball 'a guts, aaand chuck it in the water! Er...not here though...that'd be a disaster.

Go to those <hic> murloc islands, where ya found the drawing. Look for fresh wreckage in the water. That's where you gotta throw the bait.

Soon as that thing sticks its head up, chop it off! We'll make a decoration of it...for the boat!

objectives.text: Use the Big Ball o' Bait to lure out the sea monster. Then, bring its head to Argo Brinewhistle.

accept.text:
You look like you're in the habit of doing whatever other people tell ya. I like that in a lackey. With a little trainin' you could be a great asset. Let's put that to the test.

Recently some of those Eastsea pirates made off with a shipment of MY stolen goods. That's bad sportsmanship. I stole them first!

Lesson one, lackey. Never backstab a backstabber. Go show them that they messed with the wrong goblin and take back my stuff. With force, preferably.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Smuggled Goods for Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port.

accept.text:
There is a watch tower overlooking the plains to the north. It serves as an observation point to track any motion of the Horde's forces.

The watcher stationed there is named Cornelius. Speak to him and get a status report. He is all alone out there, so I like to check on him with some regularity. Fair warning, he can be a bit...taciturn. It's why he was assigned such a remote post in the first place.

complete.text: My status? There's nothing much to report. The plains are lousy with orcs, as always, and the only help Demar seems interested in sending me are greenhorns like yourself.

objectives.text: Go to Terral's Watch to get a status report from Watcher Cornelius.

complete.text:
The Wheelers are too kind!

Cassandra's right, we don't eat much besides meat and bread out here. I'll make sure everyone gets a share of these.

Thank you for the gift. I'll have to repay her kindness some time.

progress.text: Looks like you've got a delivery for me.

accept.text:
Supply delivery to this area is no easy feat. All sorts of unscrupulous characters surround us in all directions, each seeking their own piece of the pie.

Now, with that said, perhaps this is an opportunity to slow Rog'mar's growth. What do you say to throwing a little wrench in our orc friends' plans?

Head north of Rog'mar to their training grounds and steal their supply shipments. The recovery time alone ensures our forces remain battle ready while theirs... well, you see where this is going.

complete.text: Wonderful work, $N. Resupply will take some time--and that's if their caravans make it here safely.

objectives.text: Retrieve $1oa Horde Supply Shipment from the training camps north of Rog'mar.

progress.text: So...? Any luck with those supplies?

accept.text:
<The loud cries of baby Dawnbright echo through Farholde Keep. Tessa looks at you with a tired smile.>

Oh, hello there adventurer. Sorry for the noise. Little Emma here seems to be quite fussy today, but I'm not sure why. Maybe some food will help.

Do you think you could help me find something for her to eat? My husband stepped out to get some supplies so my hands are a little too full to get them myself. If you could find a few apples around here I could make a lovely mash for her.

complete.text:
Thank you so much, $N. These look absolutely delicious. Say thank you, Emma. Thank the nice $c.

<The baby refuses the food and continues to cry.>

Hm. Maybe not.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Fresh Apples for Tessa Dawnbright in Farholde Keep.

progress.text: They never tell you how much parenting is just making it up as you go. Everyone makes it look so easy.

accept.text:
My husband, Ardin, has a rare gift for sensing nature. He'll scale any peak to gather the herbs and flowers I need for my alchemy, keeping our shelves and pantry stocked.

But I fear he's wandered into trouble. An excavation crew passed through seeking supplies. They spoke, among other things, of towering grasses unlike anything they'd ever seen. Those were what he told me he had to go see for himself. He's been gone too long!

If you learn anything of him, I'd be grateful.

objectives.text: Find Ardin Grassman in the Excavation Sites.

accept.text:
With each orc we cut down, another takes its place--somehow even more capable than the last. A skilled warrior must be training this new generation. If we are to make a dent in their numbers, we need to ensure they don't have a chance to recoup their losses.

If any soldier is brave enough, it's imperative we find this blademaster and put an end to him. He is likely at the trainee camp north of the Horde outpost even now. Kill him, take his banner, and destroy the orcs' morale.

-- Ember Bladewhisper

objectives.text: Bring the Blademaster's Banner to Ember Bladewhisper in Farholde Keep.

accept.text:
<Tessa rocks her baby, trying to help her sleep.>

If she isn't hungry, maybe she's just tired. To be honest, Emma here was a delightful surprise, but that means we were a little unprepared. My husband built her this lovely bassinet, but I worry these blankets are too old. She deserves the best, after all.

If you're still willing to help, I would be forever grateful if you could find some pelts for me to line her bed with. If this stops her crying, I think everyone in Farholde would be grateful.

complete.text:
Oh you're back! You're a miracle, $N. These look so warm and inviting... and soft.

<Tessa blinks tiredly. She looks like she hasn't slept in days.>

For Emma, of course.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Coyote Pelts for Tessa Dawnbright in Farholde Keep.

progress.text:
<Tessa doesn't look up as she desperately tries to get her crying baby to sleep.>

Shh, shh. The nice, strong $c is going to help us while daddy's out.

complete.text:
<Bertrand cracks open the crate and pulls out a tankard and keg of ale.>

Now that's the stuff! We'll get this keep up in a jiffy! Yer a real lifesaver, lad.

progress.text: Did ye find me things?

accept.text:
Here ya go, champ. One drink for ol' grumpy guts over there. If this doesn't sober him up, nothin' will.

Oh and uh... wash your hands after touchin' this. And don't get it in your eyes.

complete.text:
<Gray takes the drink and chugs it greedily. He soon begins to cough and choke on the mysterious substance.>

What is in this? It tastes like death! Alright, alright. I'm listening. What do you want?

objectives.text: Deliver Zizplink's Frothing Mug to Gray Dawnbright in Powderfuse Port.

progress.text:
Oh, it's you again. I told you, I can't go back to Farholde. Not yet.

But I won't say no to another drink.

accept.text:
<Tessa's baby continues to wail loudly.>

I guess she isn't tired. Oh... everyone makes it look so easy. Her father always knows how to cheer her up. If only he'd come home already.

$n, I hate to ask this, but can you see what is taking him so long? He set out a while ago but he should have been back by now. Emma just lights up when she sees him.

You should find him at Powderfuse Port-- he seems to go there a lot lately. You'll know my Gray when you see him. He shines as brightly as the sun.

complete.text:
Tess sent you? No... I can't go home. I can't look them in the face.

How could we bring a little girl into this world? We can't protect her. We can barely protect ourselves. What kind of future can we promise her? More wars? What were we thinking...

Please don't tell Tessa. I'll go back later. Eventually.

I just need another drink.

objectives.text: Find Gray Dawnbright in Powderfuse Port.

accept.text:
Tess says little Emm can't sleep without me? And you did all that for them? A total stranger? Damn it. What was I thinking...

Even if I can't guarantee a perfect world for her, I still need to be a part of it. What am I even fighting for if I can't hope for a brighter future?

Thank you for helping my family in my absence, friend, but it's time for me to go home. If I could ask one more favor, can you pick some flowers and take them to Tess? Let her know I'll be home soon? I need to clean up first.

complete.text:
Oh these are lovely! Gray got these for me? He's always such a ray of sunshine. It's no wonder our little Emma here misses him so much. She'll be so happy when he gets back.

Isn't that right Emma? Daddy's coming home soon! Say daddy. Daddy.

<The baby stops crying and spits up on her blankets.>

It's a start. Thank you for everything, $N. You've been such a blessing. Feel free to visit us any time!

objectives.text: Gather $1oa Wildflowers and deliver them to Tessa Dawnbright in Farholde Keep.

progress.text: Good to see you again, $N. Did you find my husband?

accept.text:
Folks keep dumpin' their furry friends here like I know what I'm doin'. And then they blame me if they come back and their horse or wolf or... whatever they brought is dead or ran off. What do I look like, I'm runnin' a charity?

You look like you know your way around a trough. Mind whippin' me up some grub I can use to keep these beasties in check?

If you can't make it yourself, someone might be willin' to sell you some. And hurry! Last thing I need is a stampede of hungry animals.

objectives.text: Bring $1oa Briny Seafood Stew to Jasper Geartoggle in Powderfuse Port.

accept.text:
The skeleton is badly mangled. Deep markings on its limbs vaguely match patterns of teeth and claws. Many days beneath the beating sun have made the bones pale and brittle as well. The brutality of both the attacker and the weather have rendered the victim's identity a mystery.

You can't take the whole skeleton with you, but you could bring its skull to the nearby watchman and see what he knows.

complete.text:
<Cornelius runs his fingers along the markings left on the skull. His brow furrows more and more as he does so.>

Just what I needed...more work. You've got me into a real mess, you know that?

objectives.text: Bring the Gnawed Skull to Watcher Cornelius at Terral's Watch.

progress.text: Now what is it?

accept.text:
These markings are from a lion. By the look of them, this one's especially large. The leader of the nearby pride, most likely.

If rumor spreads about a man-eating lion prowling around on my watch, Demar will be furious. Fortunately, I have a plan.

I can make a whistle that mimics the call of a wounded tallstrider. We can use that to lure the beast out. I'll just need one of their beaks to give it the right sound. There's tallstriders all over the plains. Get me a beak, and make it snappy!

complete.text: Right then. Leave me alone for a moment so I can carve this into the proper shape.

objectives.text: Bring an Intact Tallstrider Beak to Watcher Cornelius at Terral's Watch.

progress.text: I think this goes without saying, but you'll be the one using this whistle.

accept.text:
The whistle's made, $n. 

Take it, and go to the top of the hill where the lions are. Should be just north of here.

Once you're there, blow the whistle, and our man-eater should appear. I'd tell you not to come back if you don't manage to kill him, but you'll probably be dead anyhow.

Now then, off with you. Let's see if you fare better than our skeletal friend.

complete.text:
Ah, so it is! In that case, well done.

Just so we're clear...we agree this matter doesn't need to reach Demar, yes? I'd say we handled it just fine on our own.

The man already stuck me out here. I don't need any more special attention from him.

objectives.text: Use the Tallstrider Call to call forth the leader of the lion pride. Slay the beast and retrieve its hide for Watcher Cornelius at Terral's Watch.

progress.text: If you're talking to me, I assume the lion is slain?

accept.text:
Talked to Gray, didja? Ball of laughs, that guy. Last thing he needs is you gettin' him another drink. This is an inn not a bar. He's lucky I haven't thrown him out.

You tryin' to take him with you, be my guest. Though I don't think he's in any condition to go anywhere like that. Not without a little goblin pick-me-up.

Why don't ya gather some ingredients for me from this list while I prepare your little friend his 'drink.' We'll see if he still wants booze after he's had my specialty cocktail.

complete.text: These'll do nicely. And there's plenty leftover for other customers. Ogres can't get enough of it, go figure.

objectives.text: Gather $1oa Crawler Spittle, Fresh Chum, Goblin Degreaser, and Expired Poison for Innkeeper Zizplink in Powderfuse Port.

progress.text: Nothin' cures a case of the blues like spillin' your guts-- metaphorically and literally.

accept.text:
It's dangerous enough transportin' horses 'round the glades without talk of some mysterious phantom crocolisk snappin' up my prized ponies! They say this one must be at least three times as big as a regular croc. And twice as mean!

I ain't a gamblin' man. I ain't takin' no chances with my horses till someone puts this good-fer-nothin' monster down. If anyone finds this varmint along the rivers, bring me its tooth so's I know it's safe to travel again. Till then, I'm stayin' put!

-- Wheatley

objectives.text: Bring Ghostmaw's Fang to Wheatley in Farholde Keep.

accept.text:
Well howdy there, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. Good for you. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

It's a big wide world out there and you'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful. Not sure how your outdoorsman skills are but I reckon I could teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire, get comfy. I'll walk you through it.

complete.text: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill. They will also teach you the know-how to create a proper camp fixture suitable to your new profession.

objectives.text: Sit near Sam's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.

accept.text:
One thing that never ceases to amaze me is the drive of humans. They see a desolate warzone teemin' with orcs and cultists and figure that's the perfect spot tae set up shop! Amazin'.

But, it's not me job tae tell 'em where to build. Just gotta show 'em how. And if we want this keep tae be as big as they say, we're gonna need lots o' wood.

With how dangerous the roads have become our lumber shipments from the mill tae the northwest are slowin' to a crawl. Think ye can fetch a few bundles for us?

complete.text:
Aye, these'll do nicely. Might even be able tae finish the gate at this rate.

Good thing, too. Orcs are gettin' more feisty every day.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Wood Bundles from Turner's Logging Camp for Bertrand Ironbrow in Farholde Keep.

progress.text: The mill's just northwest from here if ye can make it past the crocs an' murlocs.

accept.text:
Although I am sure we can attribute the damage to both pylons to the reckless centaur stomping about, I suspect the timing of their rampage resulted in the shards being separated. I know little about their quarrels, but I do know there are at least two main factions that have trespassed into Shen'dralas: the ferocious Magram and the cunning Gelkis.

Keeping these treasures in the midst of a battlefield would be unwise. By now, I am assuming they have taken their trophies back to their own villages.

complete.text:
The crystals are in a few more pieces than I was expecting, but this looks to be all of it. I will hold onto these for the moment. Thank you, $N.

Your next step will be to gather mana that is malleable enough to serve as both an adhesive for the broken pieces, and a conduit for the leylines to surge through thereafter.

It is quite a remarkable process, but gathering the mana may prove to be an inconvenience.

objectives.text: Recover shards and fragments of the pylons, found guarded at the Magram and Gelkis villages. Return them to Mordent Evenshade.

progress.text: I would rather not further draw the centaur's attention toward me or my fallen kin, else I would seek out the crystals myself.

accept.text:
We should be thankful that our foe is stupid. An army of ogres at their disposal, and the Twilight's Hammer have them working in the mines nowhere near the fight. I don't know if I chalk it up to mismanagement or an internal struggle, but either way they're in no position to defend themselves.

That's where we come in. With the cult's focus divided, we have an opportunity to strike the enemy while they're vulnerable and split them further. Go to this mine and sow some chaos among their ranks.

objectives.text: Defeat $1oa Ogre Miners and $2oa Twilight Subjugators in the cave near the Twilight's Shroud for Sergeant Riftan.

accept.text:
You may have seen the floating sparks of mana scattered throughout Shen'dralas. This is a new phenomenon, likely the result of the damage the pylons have endured.

We need this mana back in a semicrystallized form. We can accomplish this by using the Mana Sieve found within the temple. Borrow the sieve and collect any floating mana orbs you find.

The temple's denizens will not appreciate their precious artifact being borrowed without their consent, but they will understand in time.

complete.text:
I see you have successfully repaired the pylons--how could I not notice?

<Mordent gestures up and toward the skies, his gaze briefly followed in that direction as well. As his attention returns to you, he lofts his brow as he takes note of your seemingly lesser levels of enthusiasm.>

objectives.text: Acquire the Mana Sieve from within the temple in Shen'dralas and use it to collect Ancient Mana Crystals. Once you have acquired enough mana, empower the pylons and return to Mordent Evenshade.

progress.text: It is good to see you again, $N.

accept.text:
The fuel of the future's not coal, or oil, it's gas, baby! Those marshy ponds to the southwest spew it out by the ton, and I've got just the invention to put it to use--a new type of engine that runs on the stuff. The gas is a real pain to collect, though.

If you feel like making a humble contribution to the future of science and industry, why don't you help me get some of that gas? You can see it coming up from vents near the water.

complete.text: Excellent! These'll do real nice. Now, whaddya say to just one more favor?

objectives.text: Gather $1oa Marsh Gas Vials for Sleebo Fizzlespout.

progress.text: I hope you don't mind if I keep ya on a need-to-know basis about the finer details of my invention. Gotta protect my trade secrets, y'know?

accept.text:
You may have noticed my mechanical companion here, G45-B4G. Whirlin' around in that burlap chest of his is the one, and only, working prototype of my gas-powered engine.

I figure it's in need of some stress testing. How'd you like to take him on in a fight? I can power him up with the gas you've collected.

Oh, and don't worry about hurting him. He can't feel a thing!

complete.text:
Dang, the two of you really went at it! Couldn't have asked for a better show, and I got some great notes to boot.

I'll fix up ol' G45 here and make some changes to the engine. He'll be ready to go again in no time.

Test, tweak, test, tweak. Such is the life of a great inventor.

objectives.text: Help Sleebo test his creation.

accept.text:
If there is one thing a fighting force always needs, it's bandages. Unfortunately, Farholde has no reliable way to manufacture cloth. Thus, we depend on imports from the goblins or, if we are lucky, what we can take back from the orcs.

Currently, our supply of quality cloth is running low. I will have to start making bandages of old shirts before long. If you have the means to aid us, you would be saving many lives.

complete.text: Thank you, $N. You and I will put these to good use shortly.

objectives.text: Gather 20 Mageweave Cloth for Brother Lowley at Farholde Keep.

progress.text: Any luck procuring the cloth I requested?

accept.text:
I will fashion the cloth you've given me into bandages. In the meantime, please take these ones that I have already made, and dress the wounds of the soldiers who need it. It should be a matter of basic first aid.

Your assistance here is both necessary, and highly appreciated. I simply cannot be everywhere at once.

complete.text:
Good work. That will suffice for now.

At least until their wounds re-open, or new soldiers get brought in...

<Brother Lowley rubs his temples for a moment before re-adopting his stoic demeanor.>

objectives.text: Bandage up 3 Wounded Soldiers for Brother Lowley.

progress.text: How fare the soldiers?

accept.text:
You have done all you can here, for now.

If you wish to be of further aid, go up the hill to the chapel. It is the smaller building outside the main church.

Sister Rowland is looking after a few quarantined soldiers there who have contracted an unknown illness.

complete.text: Ah, so Brother Lowley sent you? Hard to believe he could spare the hands. That must mean you fulfilled your duties well.

objectives.text: Speak to Sister Rowland at the chapel in Farholde Keep.

accept.text:
I will spare you the grisly details, but these soldiers are violently ill. The nature of their sickness leads me to believe there is an issue with either their food or their water.

I've already checked the crops coming in from the nearby farms, so this only leaves the water, which comes from the local rivers. The best place to collect a sample is from the pools in the plains to the north. Nearly every river runs through the area, so it would be wise to check for contamination there.

complete.text: This looks... disgusting. What could be causing this sort of contamination?

objectives.text: Collect a sample of drinking water from the plains for Sister Rowland at the chapel in Farholde Keep.

progress.text: Without knowing the root cause of their illness, I can only do so much to treat these people.

accept.text:
The impurities in this sample look organic in nature. Not quite waste, but certainly something toxic.

I am no expert on wildlife, but I would guess that there is something upstream causing the water contamination. Some kind of animal, or at least a creature.

Follow the rivers as far north as you can, and see if you can find what is responsible for this. If it is an animal, it must be put down. It is for the safety of all here in Farholde.

objectives.text: Find whatever creature is causing the drinking water contamination and eliminate it. Then, return to Sister Rowland at the chapel in Farholde Keep.

accept.text:
Some researchers from Dalaran are looking for relics from the Titans and their followers, as well as their enemies in the Burning Legion. The relics are located in some tricky spots I can't reach. Recover them for me and I'll reward you generously.

Retrieve Ysera's Tear from the Shade of Eranikus in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar, a Mark of Xavius from Varrox Bleakhoof in Blackmaw Hold, and Freya's Sigil from Nanaya in the Shaper's Terrace.

objectives.text: Acquire Ysera's Tear from the Shade of Eranikus in the Sunken Temple, a Mark of Xavius from Varrox Bleakhoof in Blackmaw Hold, and Freya's Sigil from Nanaya in the Shaper's Terrace, and bring them to Pix Xizzix in Booty Bay.

accept.text:
Now that the lion hides have been collected, and the orcish poachers culled, I can finally get a break.

At least, that's what I would say, if the man who was supposed to relieve me of my watch wasn't missing.

Dunston Willis, explorer extraordinaire, went to investigate the ogre settlement to the north a few days ago. He said he'd take over my post upon his return.

Find him. If he's alive, bring him back here. If he's hanging up on meat hooks, bring me proof so Demar can send me someone else.

objectives.text: Find Dunston Willis somewhere among the ogres in Bolder'ok.

accept.text:
While war rages throughout the region, the Maraudine centaur stand unchallenged in the Valley of Spears. I worry that they will grow callous in time and stir further unrest if the other clans continue to turn a blind eye to their presence.

Khan Hratha possesses a Maraudine Key Fragment, and I wish to have it as a negotiation tactic. Find a war horn mouthpiece from the centaur there and use it to challenge him atop the highest peak.

Bring the key to me, and I will have a proposition for you.

objectives.text: Bring the Maraudine Key Fragment to Umarak in the Desolace.

accept.text:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

objectives.text: Speak with Tomas in Goldshire to learn to become a cook.

accept.text:
$n, you have proven your competence as a protector thus far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.

I've heard of a new adventurer down the road by Goldshire. Go and see what he's doing.

complete.text:
I appreciate the lookin' out, $c. That marshal's just a worrywart.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?

objectives.text: Speak to Sam Sarsparilla near Goldshire.

accept.text:
<As you sift through the debris left behind by a horrible zeppelin crash directly above, you find evidence of a hefty shipment of supplies that has long since been plundered of all its value. Even the shipping labels have been torn and shredded, leaving only the words 'Booty Bay' barely legible on one.

Countless two-toed footprints and several patches of divotted earth all lead toward ruins in the northwest.>

objectives.text: Recover $1oa Stolen Shipments from the Ruins of Zul'Kunda in Stranglethorn Vale and return your haul to someone in Booty Bay.

complete.text:
Hey, yea, that looks like what had them all rattled. Doesn't look much worse for the wear. Maybe those stiffs will stop breathin' down my neck about lost profits now.

Here, have a little somethin' for the trouble.

progress.text: I can understand why some flashy metal might work to distract one of those oafs, everything they craft is mediogre.

accept.text:
Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.

objectives.text: Speak with Herbalist Pomeroy in Elwynn Forest to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

accept.text:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.

complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Camp Chair. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

objectives.text: Speak with Helene Peltskinner in Goldshire to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

complete.text:
That's the hops smell I missed! Ye done me a great favor, $N, takes me days to leave every time I make the trip to Dun Garok myself. Hard to pull me self outta the halls o' that fortress once I get comfortable.

Happy to keep some old tastes on the shelf for fellow dwarves.

Have a little somethin' for helpin out.

progress.text: Lookin' ta try a new ale?

accept.text:
This harbor was first built by the Old Horde as a staging ground for their naval invasion of Hillsbrad. Completely circumvented Lordaeron's defenses!

So many lives lost...

What's worse is that fleet was built with the very resources they stole from Khaz Modan!

Plenty of it remains in the harbor after Admiral Proudmoore routed the brutes and built this place for the Alliance. We'll need it to bolster the town's defenses with the Dragonmaw on the move.

complete.text:
Ah! A bit damp, but nothing a few days in the sun won't fix.

Thank you, $c. It's nice to not solely rely on shipments from Theramore or Auberdine for once!

objectives.text: Recover $1oa Khaz Modan Timber and $2oa Khaz Modan Iron from Menethil Harbor for Valstag Ironjaw.

progress.text: Keep your wits about you beneath the waves. There's plenty of nasties down there!

accept.text:
The Witherbark know we be huntin' them like the traitors they are. Makin' plans and hideouts to keep their tribe in the shadows even after we burn 'em for their deceit.

Our scouts be findin' a cave west of Hiri'watha. One witch doctor, Ti'ik, he bring his voodoo inside--rot, decay, an' wrigglin' larvae for some foul magic.

We not lettin' that filth crawl through our homes while we sleep. Go, take his head, and crush whatever they be growin'. 

He be tough, so don't go underestimatin' him, ya?

complete.text:
Dis be the one. A wicked sight.

Spider eggs, maggots, none of dis be what we want in our village. 

Go on then with da loa's guidance. Revantusk be thanking you for the pest control.

objectives.text: Kill the Witherbark witch doctor known as Ti'ik in a cave west of Hiri'watha and return with his head.

progress.text: Ya go findin' Ti'ik in his cave of larvae?

accept.text:
I came to Menethil Harbor from Auberdine, from the great tree Teldrassil, to recover a bloom of great import to my people.

My people's ship the Flying Osprey crashed here many moons ago, joined with the Kul Tiran Third Fleet. Among its cargo was the flower known as Nord'el--Bloom of the Heavens in your tongue--bloomed under a full moon at the peak of Mount Hyjal, our former home.

Please help me retrieve it! The wreckage is just south of the city, but it is inhabited by fierce murloc raiders!

complete.text:
It has survived! Oh, Elune be praised!

A thousand thanks, $N. If you are willing, I do have one more favor to ask of you...

objectives.text: Recover Nord'el for Sylessa Duskwhisper in Menethil Harbor.

progress.text: Have you been to the wreckage? It is a most somber sight.

accept.text:
Would you please deliver Nord'el to elder Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine?

The boat from here should be able to get you there swiftly.

I apologize for the request, I truly do. I remain fatigued from my journey here--and from fleeing those murloc devils when I first attempted to retrieve the sacred bloom!

objectives.text:
Bring Nord'el to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine in Darkshore.

You recall Sylessa mentioning a boat in Menethil Harbor can take you there.

accept.text:
In the Second War the Dragonmaw built a fleet where we now stand, intending to take Hillsbrad. They nearly succeeded!

They were routed by the red dragons, left to mere stragglers deep in the mountains. However, there has been a surge in activity in their encampment northeast of Menethil.

Dun Algaz is proof that they intend to march to war once again and retake this land. Find their attack plans, take note of any critical information, and destroy them. We need to know where they will strike next!

objectives.text: Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep wants you to destroy the 4 sets of Attack Plans in the Angerfang Encampment.

accept.text:
Certain alchemical recipes require ingredients sourced from, well, very dangerous places. And those are often just the base herbs! The other ingredients are even worse!

I need to make more antivenom before I can leave again. I swear everything in this marsh is venomous. It's like it runs through the land itself!

Can you help me? I'll need a venom gland from the spiders in Thelgen Rock to the far southeast. But it has to be unruptured, or too much venom will spill out before you can get here. Sorry!

objectives.text: Collect an Unruptured Stalker Gland from Thelgen Rock for Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.

progress.text:
Put yer backs into it! We set sail on my word!

Oh? What's that you have there, traveler?

accept.text:
The Highlands are host to ruins of some sort, secrets now being explored by an expedition team. What I know is that they've got their own wildlife and beasts lurking in that mountain marshland. How about you take a foray in there with some well-equipped friends, and we work a trade?

I don't care if they're hiding, I want their hides! Bring me the skins from four of the Thicket Raptors, I'll have a trade worked out for you to make it worth it.

objectives.text: Return $1oa Thicket Raptor Hides to James Halloran, the tanner, in Menethil Harbor.

accept.text:
The fish just ain't biting today, and there's something wrong going on with them. It's not just empty hooks. I haven't seen a single minnow up in the water at all.

Lee here set up some traps overnight. Go check to see if we've at least got some stock there. If you find anything weird, make sure to show me.

complete.text: All the traps are like this? Seems our new neighboring nuisances are causing more destruction than we were aware of. I'll go broke if we don't do something about it.

objectives.text: Check the fishing traps in Crystal Lake.

progress.text: Any catches to speak of?

accept.text:
This can only be the work of those murlocs on the other side of the lake. They're disgusting little things, with a vicious temper and teeth to match. 

If we let this continue, there won't be any fish to speak of anywhere in this lake. If you could clear them out a bit, it would help me a ton.

complete.text: I can hear their warbling from here--it'll be in my nightmares. Well, that should slow them down--although I have no doubt that they'll make up those numbers quickly.

objectives.text: Kill $1oa Murlocs and $2oa Murloc Streamrunner at Crystal Lake, then return to Jason Mathers.

accept.text:
Remy mentioned murlocs the other day... I'm pretty sure he hates the little buggers as much as I do. 

He might have some ideas on how to keep them away from my fish in the future. I'd like to ask you to go chat with him and see if there's anything he can think of.

complete.text:
I've been warning the guards about the murlocs. They won't listen.

I have a few ideas on how to get back at those critters. I'll need your help getting what I need for it though.

objectives.text: Speak with Remy "Two Times" about Jason's murloc problems.

accept.text:
I've got a few ideas on how to deal with murlocs. And one of those also helps some others in the process.

There's a weed often found on farms in the area called duskweed, and in large quantities the petals are toxic to most animals. If we make some murloc bait with the plant, hopefully that can train those creatures to stay away.

And some farmers get their fields cleared in the process. Truly a win-win... truly a win-win.

complete.text:
Give me just a minute...

It's pretty simple bait, but as long as nobody's pet gets into it, it should be safe. Just tell Jason not to eat any of it.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Vials of Animal Blood and $2oa Duskweed Petals for murloc bait, then return to Remy "Two Times" in Goldshire.

progress.text: Find everything?

accept.text:
Tell Mathers he can come pick up the bait later today. I'll give him the rundown on the proper usage.

Hopefully he'll be able to sell his fish again soon. And we'll have less murlocs in this world.

complete.text: Poisoned bait? As long as the fish aren't going to eat it, that should work. I'll visit Remy later to pick it up.

objectives.text: Return to Jason Mathers.

accept.text:
Those fish men must think like actual fish, right? Which means anything they like, fish will like!

If you rummage through some of their junk and return to me with anything that seems like it would make good bait, I'll reward you.

complete.text:
An interesting collection. These should work well enough!

Here's some of my own older supplies. It should help anyone trying to get their footing in fishing.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa pieces of shiny junk from the nearby Murloc camp.
